ai.descriptionZh: 專為台灣社群生態設計的 AI 發文助手！輸入想法一鍵生成 IG、FB、Threads、小紅書與 LINE 社群貼文文案，免費免註冊。
ai.titleEn: AI Social Post Assistant | Instagram & Threads Copywriter | TextLab
ai.descriptionEn: Generate social posts for Instagram, Threads, Facebook, LINE and Redbook with a free AI copywriting assistant.

guideZh.h: 一句話想法變完整貼文：輸入越具體，AI 寫得越像你
guideZh.p: 不要只打「咖啡廳」三個字就按產生。把「人、事、地、感覺」四個元素寫進去：誰去、做了什麼、在哪裡、什麼感覺。例如：「今天去大安區古宅咖啡廳，抹茶拿鐵很香，窗邊陽光很美，適合獨處看書」——再選一種體裁，AI 就會照這個素材寫出鉤子＋內文＋結尾＋hashtag。輸入太空泛，產出就只能套罐頭句；輸入有細節，產出才有你的味道。

guideZh.h: 七種體裁怎麼選：同一句話，IG、Threads、LINE 寫法完全不同
guideZh.p: 不確定選什麼就用「自動」，AI 會依主題判斷意圖（開箱、探店、觀點、吐嘈、促銷、討論）再選體裁。自己選也行：IG 美學圖文重排版、氛圍感與 hashtag；FB 品牌粉專文資訊完整、口氣穩重；Threads 爆款討論開頭先丟觀點或衝突；小紅書種草提案口語推薦＋使用場景；LINE 社群特惠把價格、方案、截團、下單須知一次寫齊；職人觀點覆盤條理分明、總結 2～3 點心法。先選對體裁再貼，別把同一篇文案全平台照抄。

guideZh.h: 去 AI 味三招：餵範本、鎖禁止詞、自己改最後一句
guideZh.p: AI 文案最大的毛病是翻譯腔與罐頭連接詞，例如「在這個快節奏的時代」「讓我們一起探索」。三招破解：①餵一篇自己寫過、互動最好的貼文當風格範本，讓 AI 模仿你的斷句與語氣；②在想法裡寫明禁止詞，例如不要「極致體驗」「不容錯過」；③產出後自己改第一句和最後一句，換成你平常講話的口氣。最後務必核對價格、時間、地點等事實——AI 不會幫你查證。

guideZh.h: 品牌聲線先設定一次：之後每篇貼文都自動帶你的口氣
guideZh.p: 點「⚙️ 設定品牌聲線」，填品牌名稱、目標受眾與專屬結尾 Slogan，並把開關打開——三項缺一不可：開關沒開、或品牌名稱空白，產生時都不會帶入品牌設定。設定只存在目前瀏覽器，不會上傳。設好之後不用每篇重打受眾與語氣，AI 會自動把品牌調性套進鉤子與結尾；換品牌或換受眾時，改這裡一次就好，不用每篇在主題裡重複交代。

guideZh.h: 生成後先看三個數字：IG 前 3 行、Threads 500 字、小紅書標題 20 字
guideZh.p: 結果卡片下方會即時顯示三個提示：IG 前 3 行字數、Threads 總字數／500 字、小紅書標題字數／20 字（建議值）。IG 前 3 行決定讀者要不要點「更多」，所以把最關鍵的一句或畫面感放在前 3 行；Threads 超過 500 字要先刪到 500 字內再貼，否則貼上後會被截斷；小紅書標題超過 20 字仍可貼，但顯示可能被截斷，建議把關鍵字往前挪。先看數字再複製，比貼上後才發現超字數省事。

guideZh.h: 一稿多用工作流：生成→強化→排版→再檢查用語
guideZh.p: 不要生成完就直接貼。順序建議：①用 AI 產生貼文初稿；②用結果卡片下方的跨工具按鈕強化——加風格符號、轉花式字體、加顏文字、加熱門標籤；③按「送去排版換行」處理 IG／Threads 的換行，或按「切為 IG 輪播字卡」拆成字卡；④貼文若含促銷或敏感用詞，先丟本站「台灣用語與法規避雷器」掃一次支語與廣告高風險詞。同一篇初稿走完這四步，才能同時顧到排版、風格與用詞安全。

faqZh.q: AI 貼文助手免費嗎？需要登入或 API 金鑰嗎？
faqZh.a: 完全免費，免登入、免 API 金鑰、免信用卡，點「產生貼文」就能用。若免費額度暫時忙碌或今日額度已滿，會自動改用本機產生器繼續產出，不會產生任何費用；內容與風格沒變更時，工具會保留目前成果，避免重複消耗免費額度。

faqZh.q: AI 寫的文案可以直接貼到 IG / Threads 嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以先貼，但建議花 1 分鐘做三件事：①核對價格、時間、地點等事實；②把第一句改成你自己的口氣；③刪掉罐頭連接詞與過多驚嘆號。AI 擅長搭骨架、給靈感，「像你」的那一層要自己補。發之前也可以先用本站的 IG 換行排版與 Hook 產生器再檢查一次開頭與斷行。

faqZh.q: Threads 和 IG 可以用同一篇文案嗎？
faqZh.a: 不建議。Threads 吃「開頭觀點＋短句節奏」，前兩行沒鉤子就滑掉了；IG 吃「排版＋氛圍＋hashtag」，第一行要先給畫面感；LINE 群組則要把價格、方案、截團、下單須知一次寫齊，團友才不用往上翻。本工具的七種體裁就是按這個差異設計的——同一句話，選不同體裁，產出就是不同寫法。

faqZh.q: 我輸入的內容會被儲存或拿去訓練嗎？
faqZh.a: 本站不儲存你送出的內容。一般文字工具都在瀏覽器完成；只有 AI 貼文助手會把你送出的內容交由 Cloudflare Workers AI 處理，處理完不留存。最近使用與收藏只保存在目前瀏覽器，不會上傳。

faqZh.q: 設定了品牌聲線，為什麼產出的文案看起來沒變？
faqZh.a: 先檢查兩件事：①品牌聲線開關有沒有打開；②品牌名稱欄位有沒有填。兩者缺一，產生時都不會帶入品牌設定。另外要注意防重複機制：主題文字與風格都沒變時，再按產生會保留目前成果、不重新消耗額度——所以改完品牌設定後，要稍微改動主題文字或換一種風格再產生，才會看到新版本。

faqZh.q: 免費 AI 額度用完或忙碌時會怎樣？會收費嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會收費。免費 AI 暫時忙碌或今日額度已滿時，工具會自動改用本機產生器繼續產出，並提示你已切換。本機版是套版式產出（固定鉤子、銜接句與結尾組合），品質不如線上 AI 細緻，但可以直接用；等額度恢復後，換一點主題文字再產生一次，就能回到 AI 版本。

faqZh.q: 連點「產生貼文」為什麼沒反應，還出現冷卻倒數？
faqZh.a: 這是防連點與防重複機制：每次產生後有 3 秒冷卻，冷卻中按鈕會顯示倒數且無法重按；主題與風格完全沒變時再按，會直接保留目前成果並提示你，避免重複消耗免費額度。想換一版就改主題文字、換風格，或等冷卻結束後再按。

faqZh.q: 小紅書標題「20 字（建議）」是硬性上限嗎？
faqZh.a: 不是硬性上限，是建議值。結果卡片顯示的是第一行字數／20 字，提醒你標題太長在小紅書顯示時可能被截斷。超過 20 字仍可複製貼上，但建議把最吸引人的關鍵字往標題前面挪，讓讀者在被截斷前就看到重點；也可以把次要資訊移到內文第一段。

guideEn.h: One idea, one complete post: the more specific your input, the more it sounds like you
guideEn.p: Don't just type “café” and hit generate. Give the AI four ingredients — who, what, where, how it felt. For example: “I visited a vintage café in Da'an District today. The matcha latte was fragrant, the window light was beautiful, and it felt perfect for reading alone.” Pick a format, and the tool returns a hook + body + closing + hashtags built from your material. Vague input gets canned lines; specific input gets your voice.

guideEn.h: Pick the right format: the same idea reads differently on IG, Threads, and LINE
guideEn.p: Not sure which to pick? Use “Auto” and the AI judges the intent (unboxing, café visit, opinion, rant, promotion, discussion) and picks the format. Or choose yourself: IG aesthetic leans on layout, mood, and hashtags; FB brand page is complete info in a steady tone; Threads hot take leads with a viewpoint or tension; Redbook seeding is a chatty recommendation plus use cases; LINE deal packs price, plan, deadline, and ordering rules into one message; pro reflection is structured with 2–3 takeaways. Choose the format first — don't copy-paste one draft everywhere.

guideEn.h: De-AI your draft in three moves: feed a sample, ban clichés, rewrite the last line
guideEn.p: AI copy's biggest flaw is translated-sounding filler, like “In this fast-paced era…” or “Let's explore together…”. Three fixes: ① feed it a post you wrote that performed well, as a style sample, so the AI mimics your sentence rhythm and tone; ② list banned phrases in your idea, e.g. no “ultimate experience” or “don't miss out”; ③ rewrite the first and last lines in your own speaking voice. Always verify facts — prices, times, places — the AI won't check them for you.

guideEn.h: Set your brand voice once, and every post sounds like you
guideEn.p: Open “⚙️ Configure” under Brand Voice Persona and fill in your brand name, target audience, and custom closing slogan — then switch it on. All three matter: if the switch is off, or the brand name is blank, the setting is not included when generating. The setting lives only in your current browser and is never uploaded. Once set, you stop re-explaining your audience and tone in every prompt; the AI folds your brand voice into the hook and closing. Change brands or audiences by editing this one place.

guideEn.h: Check three numbers after generating: IG first 3 lines, Threads 500, Redbook title 20
guideEn.p: Below the result card you get three live hints: characters in the first 3 lines for IG, total characters out of 500 for Threads, and first-line characters out of a suggested 20 for a Redbook title. The IG first 3 lines decide whether readers tap “more”, so put your strongest line or image up there. Over 500 characters for Threads must be trimmed before posting, or the paste will be cut off. Over 20 for a Redbook title still pastes, but the display may truncate it — move the keyword forward.

guideEn.h: One draft, many uses: generate, enhance, reformat, then check wording
guideEn.p: Do not paste the first draft straight away. A better order: ① generate the draft with AI; ② enhance it with the buttons under the result card — add style symbols, convert to a fancy font, append a kaomoji, or add trending hashtags; ③ send it to the line-break layout tool for IG/Threads, or split it into IG carousel cards; ④ if the post contains promotions or sensitive wording, run it through this site's Taiwan Voice & Legal Sanitizer first for mainland phrasing and high-risk advertising terms. One draft through these four steps covers layout, style, and wording safety at once.

faqEn.q: Is the AI post assistant free? Do I need an API key?
faqEn.a: Completely free — no sign-up, no API key, no credit card. Hit “Generate post” and go. If the free quota is busy or used up for the day, the tool automatically switches to the local generator so you can keep working at no cost; unchanged content and style reuse the current result instead of spending quota again.

faqEn.q: Can I post the AI draft to Instagram or Threads as-is?
faqEn.a: You can, but spend one minute on three checks: ① verify facts like prices, times, and places; ② rewrite the first line in your own voice; ③ cut canned transitions and stacked exclamation marks. AI is great at structure and ideas — the layer that sounds like you is yours to add. Run the hook and line-break tools here for a final check before posting.

faqEn.q: Can I use the same copy for Threads and Instagram?
faqEn.a: Not recommended. Threads rewards a strong opening viewpoint and short-sentence rhythm — no hook in the first two lines and readers scroll past. Instagram rewards layout, mood, and hashtags, with the first line setting the scene. A LINE group needs price, plan, deadline, and ordering rules in one message. The tool's formats are built around exactly these differences.

faqEn.q: Is what I type stored or used for training?
faqEn.a: This site does not store your submitted content. Regular text tools run entirely in your browser; only the AI Post Assistant sends your input to Cloudflare Workers AI for processing, and it is not retained. Recents and favorites stay in this browser and are never uploaded.

faqEn.q: I set my brand voice, but the copy looks unchanged. Why?
faqEn.a: Check two things first: ① whether the brand voice switch is on, and ② whether the brand name field is filled in. If either is missing, the brand setting is not included when generating. Also note the duplicate guard: if the topic text and style are unchanged, pressing generate again keeps the current result instead of spending more free quota — so after changing your brand voice, tweak the topic text or switch styles before generating again.

faqEn.q: What happens when the free AI quota is used up or busy? Is there a charge?
faqEn.a: There is no charge. When the free AI is busy or today's quota is full, the tool automatically falls back to the local generator and tells you it has switched. The local version is template-based (fixed hooks, bridges, and closings), so it is less nuanced than the online AI version, but it is usable right away; once the quota recovers, change the topic text slightly and generate again for the AI version.

faqEn.q: Why does nothing happen when I click “Create post” repeatedly, and why is there a cooldown?
faqEn.a: That is the anti-double-click and duplicate guard: after each generation there is a 3-second cooldown, during which the button shows a countdown and cannot be pressed again. If the topic and style are completely unchanged, pressing again simply keeps the current result to avoid spending free quota twice. To get a new version, edit the topic text, change styles, or wait for the cooldown to end.

faqEn.q: Is the Redbook title “20 characters (suggested)” a hard limit?
faqEn.a: No, it is a suggested value, not a hard limit. The result card shows the first line's character count against 20 to warn you that a long title may be truncated in Redbook's display. Longer titles still copy and paste fine, but move your most compelling keyword to the front of the title so readers see it before any truncation — or move secondary details into the first paragraph.

hook.titleZh: 爆款 Hook 產生器｜Threads / IG / 小紅書勾魂開頭與標題公式｜字研所 TextLab
hook.descriptionZh: 專為台灣小編設計的爆款 Hook 第一句產生器！收錄好奇反常識、觀點思考、共鳴情感與強導購開頭模板，拯救發文零點擊。
hook.titleEn: Viral Social Caption Hook Studio | High-Converting Hooks | TextLab
hook.descriptionEn: Create high-converting opening lines and caption hooks for Instagram, Threads and Redbook social posts.

guideZh.h: Threads／IG 開頭第一句：前 125 字決定要不要點開
guideZh.p: 在 IG 動態牆，文案大約前 125 字後會被折疊成「…更多」；Threads 則是開頭第一句直接決定讀者滑不滑走。勾子一定要放最前面：具體數字、反常識主張，或沒說完的懸念。把主題貼進本工具、選一個分類，一鍵產生第一句，再接著寫正文就好。

guideZh.h: 四大開頭公式怎麼選：好奇／觀點／共鳴／導購
guideZh.p: 「好奇反常識」適合乾貨、教學、冷知識——用【】符號＋否定句製造認知落差；「觀點思考」適合 Threads 討論串——第一句先亮立場再給論據；「共鳴情感」適合深夜文、療癒系——用「致每一個…」直接點名讀者；「導購促銷」專為團購開團設計——倒數、限量、社群限定價三件套，直接把賣點寫進第一句。

guideZh.h: 開團小編專用：導購促銷開頭三件套
guideZh.p: 團購文的開頭不是介紹商品，而是給「立刻下單」的理由：①倒數製造急迫（最後倒數 6 小時）②算帳證明划算（算給你看為什麼一定要跟）③社群限定製造稀缺（獨家社群限定價）。把商品名＋優惠貼進主題欄，選「導購促銷」分類，產生的開頭可直接用在 LINE 群、IG 限動和 Threads 開團文。

guideZh.h: 同一主題一次出 16 句：先篩分類，再挑一句貼
guideZh.p: 本工具是 4 個分類各 4 種句式，同一主題一次共 16 句。先點分類按鈕只看一類：乾貨教學看「好奇反常識」、討論串看「觀點思考」、深夜療癒文看「共鳴情感」、開團文看「導購促銷」。一次只挑一句貼出去，剩下的先留著——同一主題換開頭重發測試時，那些就是現成的對照組，不用每次重想。

guideZh.h: 工具只產第一句：勾子後面第一句要立刻給料
guideZh.p: 勾子只是讓人停下來，正文第一句才是讓人留下來。貼上開頭後，下一句立刻給證據、故事或數字：例如開頭是「改了 5 版草稿之後，我終於悟出了一個道理」，下一句就寫第一版錯在哪、改了什麼。只貼勾子、正文卻繞圈子，讀者點開又滑走，下次看到你的開頭就不會再停。

guideZh.h: 同一篇正文換 2 到 3 個開頭測試，數字別亂寫
guideZh.p: 同一篇正文可以換開頭分開發測試，但不要連續洗版，隔幾天再發一次，留互動最好的那句當固定範本。數字型勾子要特別小心：工具裡有「90% 的人都不知道」這類句式，沒有真實數據支撐就不要照貼，改成自己的經驗數字，例如「我改了 5 版草稿之後」——真實的數字比誇大的比例更有說服力，也不會踩誤導的線。

faqZh.q: Threads 貼文有字數限制嗎？開頭要寫多長？
faqZh.a: 有，一則貼文最多 500 字元，超過可以加上最多 10,000 字元的文字附件寫長文。不管長短，第一句都是勾子：把最有料的一句放在開頭，讓讀者在滑過的瞬間就停住，再用本工具產生開頭、接著寫正文即可。

faqZh.q: IG 文案開頭幾字最關鍵？被折疊怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: IG 動態牆的文案約前 125 字後會被折疊成「…更多」（官方沒公布精確數字，這是第三方實測的常見值）。所以結論、賣點、懸念都要寫進前 125 字；文案總上限是 2,200 字。被折疊是正常的，把勾子放前面就不怕。

faqZh.q: 開頭加【】、🔥 這種符號會被演算法降觸及嗎？
faqZh.a: 目前沒有任何官方說法指出裝飾符號會被降觸及。演算法看的是互動（停留、按讚、分享），符號只是讓第一句在視覺上跳出來、提高停住率。真正該避免的是整篇全是符號，或標題與內容不符——讀者點開發現被騙，下次就不點了。

faqZh.q: 同一個開頭可以用在 IG、Threads 和小紅書嗎？
faqZh.a: 公式可以共用，但語氣要調：Threads 適合口語、有立場的觀點句；IG 適合短、美、有懸念的文案開頭；小紅書則吃「標題黨＋乾貨承諾」的組合（例如保母級教程、避雷）。本工具產生的開頭是通用模板，貼上前按平台微調第一句的語氣即可。

faqZh.q: 產生的開頭可以直接複製貼上嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以，點「一鍵複製」就能直接貼到 Threads、IG 或小紅書。但建議先檢查一句：主題是不是你自己的真實經驗或數字。模板給的是骨架，正文還是要自己接著寫，勾子加正文合起來才是完整貼文。

faqZh.q: 主題欄不知道要寫什麼，怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 不用寫完整文案，只要一句核心主張或經驗就好。越具體、工具產出的開頭越像你的話，例如預設範例「把心態放慢之後，工作效率反而變高了」。只寫「工作」「生活」這種大詞，產出的開頭也會跟著空泛。

faqZh.q: 開頭加正文合起來超過 Threads 500 字怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: Threads 是一則貼文最多 500 字元，勾子本身不長，超標通常是正文太長。先用本站的字數計數器檢查全文，超了先砍正文的贅字和重複句，不要砍勾子——勾子被砍掉，整篇的停留效果就沒了。

faqZh.q: 「90% 的人都不知道」這種句子可以直接用嗎？
faqZh.a: 沒有真實數據支撐就不要照貼。絕對比例聽起來有力，但讀者一追問數據來源就穿幫，還有誤導的風險。改成自己的經驗數字，例如「我改了 5 版草稿之後才發現」，真實、可驗證，效果往往更好。

guideEn.h: The first 125 characters decide the click
guideEn.p: On the Instagram feed, captions get truncated behind "…more" after roughly the first 125 characters; on Threads, the opening line is all a scroller sees before deciding. Put the hook up front: a specific number, a counter-intuitive claim, or an unfinished thought. Type your topic into this tool, pick a category, and generate a first line before writing the body.

guideEn.h: Four hook formulas and when to use each
guideEn.p: Curiosity & contrarian works for tutorials and tips — bracketed callouts and negative statements create a knowledge gap. Perspective & opinion fits Threads discussions — state your stance in line one, then argue. Empathy & emotion fits late-night, comforting posts — address the reader directly, like "to everyone still grinding at 2am…". Sales & urgency is built for group-buy posts — countdowns, limited stock, community-only pricing, right in the first line.

guideEn.h: Threads vs Instagram vs Xiaohongshu: adapt the tone
guideEn.p: The formulas travel, the tone doesn't. Threads rewards conversational, opinionated openers. Instagram wants short, aesthetic, suspenseful first lines. Xiaohongshu responds to bold tutorial-style promises ("nanny-level guide", "avoid these pitfalls"). Generate a hook here, then tune the tone for the platform before posting.

guideEn.h: One topic, 16 lines: filter by category, then pick one
guideEn.p: This tool gives 16 lines per topic: 4 categories with 4 phrasings each. Filter to one category first: curiosity for how-tos, perspective for discussion threads, empathy for late-night reflective posts, and sales for group-buy posts. Post only one line at a time and keep the rest — they become ready-made variants when you test a different hook on the same body later.

guideEn.h: The tool only writes the first line: follow it with substance immediately
guideEn.p: A hook only stops the scroll; the next sentence is what keeps the reader. After pasting the hook, follow it at once with evidence, a story, or a number: if the hook says you rewrote a draft five times, the next sentence should say what was wrong with the first version. A hook followed by filler teaches readers to skip your hooks next time.

guideEn.h: Test 2 to 3 hooks on the same post — and do not invent numbers
guideEn.p: You can repost the same body with a different hook a few days apart, but do not flood the feed back-to-back; keep whichever hook earned the best response as your template. Be careful with number hooks: phrasings like "90% of people don't know" need real data behind them. Without it, swap in your own experience — "after rewriting the draft 5 times" — which is verifiable and usually more persuasive.

faqEn.q: Is there a character limit on Threads posts?
faqEn.a: Yes — 500 characters per post, with an optional text attachment of up to 10,000 characters for longer writing. Either way, the opening line is the hook: put your strongest sentence first so scrollers stop before swiping past.

faqEn.q: How long can an Instagram caption be?
faqEn.a: Up to 2,200 characters, but only about the first 125 show in the feed before "…more" (Instagram publishes no official number; ~125 is the commonly tested figure). Put your conclusion, offer, or cliffhanger inside those first 125 characters.

faqEn.q: Do brackets and emojis in the first line hurt reach?
faqEn.a: No official statement from Instagram or Meta says decorative symbols reduce reach. Ranking follows engagement (dwell time, likes, shares); symbols just make the first line visually pop so people stop scrolling. What actually hurts you is a hook that overpromises — readers who feel tricked won't click next time.

faqEn.q: How many hashtags can I use on Instagram?
faqEn.a: Instagram Help now says up to 5 hashtags per post. Put them at the end of the caption or in a comment — never in the first 125 characters, where they would crowd out your hook.

faqEn.q: Can I paste a generated hook as-is?
faqEn.a: Yes, the copy button pastes it straight into Threads, Instagram, or Xiaohongshu. Still, check one thing first: is the topic your own real experience or number? The template is a frame; you still need to write the body that follows it.

faqEn.q: What should I type in the topic field?
faqEn.a: You do not need a full draft — one core claim or experience is enough. The more specific it is, the more the hook sounds like you. A vague word like "work" produces a vague hook; a concrete sentence like "slowing down made me more productive" gives the templates something real to work with.

faqEn.q: What if the hook plus body exceeds the Threads 500-character limit?
faqEn.a: Threads counts the whole post, and the hook itself is short — overruns usually come from the body. Check the full text with this site's character counter first, then trim filler from the body rather than cutting the hook; without the hook, the post loses its stopping power.

faqEn.q: Can I use a line like "90% of people don't know"?
faqEn.a: Not without real data behind it. Absolute percentages sound strong, but they fall apart the moment a reader asks for the source, and they risk misleading people. Use your own experience instead — "after rewriting the draft 5 times" — which is verifiable and often more convincing.

guideZh.h: IG 貼文標題怎麼裝飾？日系花邊讓第一行停留率翻倍
guideZh.p: 滑社群時大家停留的時間不到 3 秒，一個有裝飾的標題行（例：✦ ─── 今日穿搭 ─── ✦）比光禿禿的文字更容易讓人停下來。本工具提供 12 種版式：星閃雙邊、愛心對稱、日系蝴蝶結 ౨ৎ、璀璨星光、角括號『 』、黑大括號【 】等，輸入文字即時預覽 12 種效果，一鍵複製貼到 IG 內文分段標題、Threads 貼文分隔線或限動文字，不用自己一個一個打符號。

guideZh.h: 花邊標題的排版心法：整篇貼文只用一種風格
guideZh.p: 裝飾的最大地雷是混搭——第一行用蝴蝶結、第二行用星閃、第三行用黑大括號，整篇貼文立刻變雜亂。建議一篇貼文鎖定一種風格（可愛風選 ౨ৎ 日系蝴蝶結＋夢幻蕾絲，俐落風選【 】黑大括號＋角括號）。標題字數超過 15 個字時選簡潔框線款，避免手機上換行被切斷；要加強層次感可以去站內花式字體工具把標題字先變形，再套上邊框。

guideZh.h: 貼到 IG 或遊戲變成方框？選相容性最高的三款
guideZh.p: 有些冷門裝飾字（例如奢華星光的組合字元）在舊款 Android 或部分遊戲暱稱欄位會缺字變成方框。最穩的三款是：【 】黑大括號、『 』角括號、[ ] 日系方括號——這幾個是 CJK 常用符號，幾乎所有裝置和平台都能正常顯示。要用的情境如果吃相容性（遊戲 ID、IG Bio、LINE 名稱），直接選這三款；IG 內文和 Threads 則 12 種全都可以用。

faqZh.q: 日系花邊標題是什麼？
faqZh.a: 就是用特殊符號把標題框起來裝飾的排版方式，常見於日系 IG 貼文和 Threads，例如 ౨ৎ 今日穿搭 ౨ৎ、✦ ─── 好物分享 ─── ✦。功能是讓標題在資訊流中更顯眼、分段更清楚。本工具輸入文字就能即時套用 12 種花邊版式並一鍵複製，不用記符號怎麼打。

faqZh.q: 複製貼上到 IG 後變成方框 □ 怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 那是缺字：你用的裝飾字元在該裝置或 App 沒有對應的字形。解法是換成相容性最高的三款——【 】黑大括號、『 』角括號、[ ] 日系方括號，它們是 CJK 常用符號，幾乎所有手機和平台都支援。IG 內文和 Threads 比較寬容，12 種版式通常都能正常顯示。

faqZh.q: 花邊標題可以用在 IG 簡介 Bio 嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以，但要克制。Bio 只有 150 字額度，一個花邊框就會吃掉好幾個字，建議只在名字行或第一行用一次簡潔款（例如『 』角括號）。主戰場其實是貼文內文的分段小標和 Threads 的分隔線，那裡字數寬鬆，裝飾效果也最好。

faqZh.q: 用特殊符號裝飾標題，會影響 IG 搜尋或觸及嗎？
faqZh.a: IG 搜尋主要看帳號名稱、Bio 關鍵字和貼文第一段的實際文字，裝飾符號本身不會被當成關鍵字，也不會降觸及。實務建議是：真正的關鍵字（例如「台北咖啡廳」）用純文字寫在花邊框裡面，這樣搜尋抓得到、視覺又好看，兩邊都顧到。

guideEn.h: How to Decorate Instagram Post Titles: Aesthetic Frames That Stop the Scroll
guideEn.p: People spend less than 3 seconds on a post before scrolling. A decorated title line (e.g., ✦ ─── OUTFIT OF THE DAY ─── ✦) is far more likely to stop the scroll than plain text. This tool offers 12 frame styles — star dividers, heart symmetry, Japanese ribbon ౨ৎ, sparkles, corner brackets 『 』, heavy brackets 【 】 and more — with live previews for each. Type once, copy in one click, and paste into Instagram captions, Threads dividers, or Story text. No need to type each symbol by hand.

guideEn.h: The Golden Rule of Decorated Titles: One Style Per Post
guideEn.p: The biggest mistake is mixing styles — ribbons on line one, sparkles on line two, heavy brackets on line three — and the post instantly looks chaotic. Lock one style per post: pick the ౨ৎ ribbon + lace for a cute vibe, or 【 】 heavy brackets for a clean look. For titles longer than 15 characters, choose the simpler frame styles so nothing breaks on narrow phone screens. Pair with the fancy fonts tool to stylize the title text before framing it for extra depth.

guideEn.h: Boxes Instead of Symbols? Use the Three Most Compatible Frames
guideEn.p: Some exotic decorative characters (like the composite glyphs in the luxury sparkle style) can render as boxes on older Android phones or in certain game nickname fields. The three safest frames are: 【 】 heavy brackets, 『 』 corner brackets, and [ ] square brackets — all common CJK punctuation supported by virtually every device and platform. For compatibility-sensitive spots (game IDs, Instagram bios, LINE display names), use these three; for Instagram captions and Threads, all 12 styles work fine.

faqEn.q: What is an aesthetic title frame?
faqEn.a: It's a typography decoration style where the title is wrapped in special symbols, popular in Japanese-style Instagram posts and Threads — e.g., ౨ৎ OUTFIT OF THE DAY ౨ৎ or ✦ ─── HAUL ─── ✦. It makes titles stand out in the feed and clarifies section breaks. This tool applies 12 frame styles to your text instantly with one-click copy, so you never have to memorize the symbols.

faqEn.q: Why do the frames turn into boxes □ after pasting into Instagram?
faqEn.a: That's a missing-glyph issue: the device or app doesn't have a font for that decorative character. Switch to the three most compatible frames — 【 】 heavy brackets, 『 』 corner brackets, [ ] square brackets — all common CJK punctuation supported on virtually every phone and platform. Instagram captions and Threads are more forgiving, and all 12 styles usually display fine there.

faqEn.q: Can I use decorated titles in my Instagram bio?
faqEn.a: Yes, but sparingly. Bios have a 150-character limit and each frame eats several characters, so use a simple frame (like 『 』 corner brackets) on the name line or first line only. The real showcase is in caption section headers and Threads divider lines, where character limits are generous and the decoration shines.

faqEn.q: Do decorative symbols hurt Instagram search or reach?
faqEn.a: Instagram search keys off your account name, bio keywords, and the actual words in the first lines of captions — decorative symbols are not indexed as keywords and don't reduce reach. Best practice: put real keywords (e.g., "Taipei cafes") in plain text inside the frame, so search engines can read them while the visuals stay pretty.

guideZh.h: IG 貼文換行為什麼會被吃掉？

guideZh.h: Threads 貼文怎麼排版好看？
guideZh.p: Threads 適合短段落加空行分隔重點：一段一個想法，段與段之間留空行，重點句可以用特殊符號或顏文字點綴。本站排版工具可即時預覽，避免發出去才發現擠成一團。

guideZh.h: 排版時空白字元怎麼用？
guideZh.p: 單純按 Enter 的空行有時會被平台吃掉。在需要強制留白的地方插入透明空白字元，換行就不會消失；空白字元可到本站「透明空白文字產生器」一鍵複製。

faqZh.q: IG 限動的文字可以換行排版嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以。先在本工具排好版、複製，再到 IG 限動的文字框貼上；建議分段不要太多，限動版面較小，段落太長會被截斷。

faqZh.q: 複製過去的排版在 Android 和 iPhone 看起來一樣嗎？

faqZh.q: 排版工具是免費的嗎？

faqZh.q: 可以排好直接發佈到 IG 嗎？
faqZh.a: 不行，本站是排版輔助工具。排好後一鍵複製，到 IG App 手動貼上發佈。

guideEn.h: Why does Instagram eat my line breaks?
guideEn.p: Instagram strips consecutive line breaks and leading spaces, turning a nicely formatted caption into a wall of text. Format it in this tool first, check the preview, then copy and paste to keep your paragraph spacing.

guideEn.h: How to format Threads posts?
guideEn.p: Threads reads best with short paragraphs separated by blank lines: one idea per paragraph, with key lines accented by symbols or kaomoji. Use the preview here to avoid posting a cramped block of text.

faqEn.q: Can I format text for Instagram Stories?
faqEn.a: Yes. Format it here, copy it, then paste into the Story text box. Keep paragraphs short, as Story space is limited.

faqEn.q: Does the formatting look the same on Android and iPhone?
faqEn.a: Mostly yes. Both systems handle line breaks and blank characters the same way; very old devices may show boxes for rare symbols.

faqEn.q: Is it free?

bio.descriptionEn: Design Instagram and Threads bios with Unicode fonts, symbols, dividers and profile layout templates.

guideZh.h: IG Bio 黃金四行：名字行、定位行、標籤行、行動呼籲
guideZh.p: 好看的 Bio 都是四行結構：第一行姓名或稱呼讓人記住你是誰；第二行身份定位一句話說清楚你分享什麼（例：☁️ Slow living & coffee）；第三行城市或標籤加地區感；第四行動呼籲放 👇🏼 引導點連結。本工具四個欄位正好對應這四行，右上角即時顯示字數（x/150），填完一鍵複製貼上即可。

guideZh.h: Threads 簡介可以跟 IG Bio 共用嗎？可以，但語氣要換
guideZh.p: Threads 的氛圍比 IG 更隨性口語，太精緻的 Bio 在那裡反而顯得生硬。建議共用骨架、改寫語氣：IG 版用「🎨 Digital Product Designer」，Threads 版改成「畫圖的，偶爾寫字」。工具內建「Threads 思考紀錄」範本，一鍵套用再微調，比從零寫快得多。連結只留最重要的那一個。

guideZh.h: Bio 換行儲存後被吃掉？用空白字元留白
guideZh.p: IG 會把完全空白的行壓掉，這是很多人排好版、儲存後又黏在一起的原因。解法是在想留白的行放一個看不見的 Unicode 字元：ㅤ（U+3164）或 ⠀（U+2800）。先在手機備忘錄把整段 Bio 排好（空行放空白字元），再一次整段複製貼到 IG，比在 IG 輸入框裡直接打穩定得多。

guideZh.h: 名字行不要只寫名字：放「名字＋主題關鍵字」
guideZh.p: 本工具第 1 欄對應的是顯示名稱，不是 @ 帳號名稱：顯示名稱可以放中文、符號和主題關鍵字，而且會被搜尋。只寫「米亞」，別人搜「台北美食」找不到你；改成「米亞｜台北美食」，第一眼就知道你是誰、分享什麼。@ 帳號名稱則是全站唯一的識別碼，決定你的個人檔案網址和別人標註你的方式，改了會影響舊連結，所以 @ID 求穩、好記就好，關鍵字補在名字行。

guideZh.h: 範本套用後三步改寫，才不會跟別人撞款
guideZh.p: 工具內建 5 款範本（極簡質感、創作者／設計師、美食＆咖啡日誌、軟萌日系、Threads 思考紀錄），套用只是起點。第一步把名字行換成自己的名字＋主題；第二步把定位行換成你真正分享的內容，不要留範例的「Slow living & coffee」；第三步只留 1～2 個代表你的符號，範例的城市、聯絡信箱一併換掉。套用後直接複製貼上，最容易露餡的就是沒改掉的範例內容。

guideZh.h: 連結放幾個才對：一般帳號最多 5 個，但行動呼籲只指一個
guideZh.p: 現在 IG 個人檔案連結一般帳號最多可以放 5 個，不必為了塞連結另外開連結頁工具；超過 5 個、或想追蹤每個連結的點擊，才需要外部連結頁。重點是順序：把最重要的設為主要連結，Bio 第 4 行的行動呼籲只指那一個，例如「👇🏼 最新食記在連結」。連結換了主題，行動呼籲那行也要跟著換，否則點進去的內容跟 Bio 講的不一樣，人就走了。

faqZh.q: IG Bio 有字數限制嗎？
faqZh.a: 有，150 字。一個 Emoji 約佔 1～2 字，裝飾符號和換行也都算字數，寫太滿會被截斷。本工具右上角即時顯示「x/150」字數，超過就刪減幾句再貼，避免送出後才發現被吃字。

faqZh.q: 花式字體用在 IG 簡介會變成方框嗎？
faqZh.a: 看字體冷門程度。常見的粗體、斜體、全形等風格在主流手機都能正常顯示；太冷門的裝飾字在舊款 Android 或部分裝置可能缺字變方框。建議先用工具的即時預覽看效果，拿不定主意就改用 ★✦ 這類幾乎不會缺字的符號。需要靈感可以去站內的花式字體工具挑。

faqZh.q: Bio 排好換行，儲存後又黏在一起怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 通常是空白行被 IG 壓掉了。在空白行貼入空白字元 ㅤ（U+3164），讓那一行「看起來空白但實際有字元」，就能保留留白。如果直接按 Enter 換行已經能正常保留，就不需要加空白字元。

faqZh.q: 個人帳號的 Bio 跟創作者帳號寫法有什麼不同？
faqZh.a: 個人帳號挑 2～3 項最能代表你的興趣就好，Bio 不是履歷，不用把星座、MBTI、工作全塞進去。創作者或工作帳號則要加「分享主題＋聯絡方式」，讓第一次看到的人秒懂這個帳號在做什麼。工具內建「創作者 / 設計師」範本，一鍵套用就有專業骨架。

faqZh.q: IG Bio 可以放幾個連結？
faqZh.a: 一般帳號最多 5 個（訂閱 Meta One 方案可放更多）。放滿 5 個不代表有效：訪客通常只點第一個看到的主要連結，所以先決定哪一個最重要、設為主要連結，再讓 Bio 第 4 行的行動呼籲指著它，其他連結只是備用。

faqZh.q: 顯示名稱和 @ 帳號名稱有什麼不同？
faqZh.a: 顯示名稱就是 Bio 頂端的名字行，可以放中文、符號和主題關鍵字，也會被搜尋，改寫成本低；@ 帳號名稱是全站唯一的 ID，決定個人檔案網址和別人標註你的方式，改了會影響舊連結和舊標註。本工具第 1 欄填的就是顯示名稱，@ID 另外在 IG 設定裡改，兩者要分開想。

faqZh.q: Threads 簡介也是 150 字嗎？
faqZh.a: 是，同樣以 150 字為上限，本工具右上角的 x/150 計數器兩邊都適用。差別在語氣：Threads 比 IG 更口語，骨架可以共用，但定位行要重寫成像跟朋友講話的句子，太精緻的 IG 版 Bio 直接搬過去會顯得生硬。

faqZh.q: Bio 超過 150 字被截斷，先刪什麼？
faqZh.a: 照這個順序刪：先刪重複的裝飾符號，再刪城市／標籤行，最後刪行動呼籲的贅字；名字行和定位行最後才動，因為那兩行決定別人要不要追蹤你。刪到工具計數器顯示 150 以內再貼，不要貼上後才發現結尾被吃掉。

guideEn.h: The 4-line bio formula that works everywhere
guideEn.p: Good bios follow a four-line structure: line 1 is your name or handle so people remember you; line 2 is your role in one phrase (e.g. ☁️ Slow living & coffee); line 3 is your city or tags; line 4 is a call to action with 👇🏼 pointing to your link. This tool's four fields map exactly to those lines, with a live character counter (x/150) up top — fill them in, copy, and paste.

guideEn.h: Can I reuse my Instagram bio on Threads? Yes, but change the tone
guideEn.p: Threads feels more casual than Instagram, and a polished IG bio can look stiff there. Keep the same skeleton but rewrite the tone: '🎨 Digital Product Designer' on IG becomes something like 'designer, occasional writer' on Threads. The built-in 'Threads Thoughts' template gives you a one-click starting point to tweak. Keep just your single most important link.

guideEn.h: Line breaks disappearing? Use invisible characters
guideEn.p: Instagram collapses fully empty lines, which is why a nicely spaced bio turns into one blob after saving. Put an invisible Unicode character on the lines you want to keep blank: ㅤ (U+3164) or ⠀ (U+2800). Compose the whole bio in your phone's notes app first (with invisible characters on the blank lines), then paste it into Instagram in one go — far more reliable than typing in IG's own editor.

guideEn.h: Don't put just your name on line 1: use 'name + niche keyword'
guideEn.p: The tool's first field is your display name, not your @ handle: the display name can hold other languages, symbols and niche keywords, and it is searchable. Just 'Mia' tells nobody what you post; 'Mia | Taipei food' says who you are and what you share at a glance. Your @ handle is the unique ID behind your profile URL and mentions, so keep it stable and memorable — put the keywords in the display name instead.

guideEn.h: After applying a template, rewrite it in three steps
guideEn.p: The tool ships five templates (Minimalist, Creator / Designer, Food & Coffee, Kawaii & Soft, Threads Thoughts) — applying one is only the starting point. First, swap line 1 for your own name plus niche; second, rewrite line 2 with what you actually post instead of the sample 'Slow living & coffee'; third, keep just one or two signature symbols and replace the sample city and contact email. Pasting a template unchanged is most obvious exactly where the sample text survives.

guideEn.h: How many links? Up to 5 on a regular account — but point the CTA at one
guideEn.p: A regular Instagram account can now add up to 5 bio links, so you don't need an external link page just to hold a few links; you only need one if you pass 5 links or want per-link click tracking. What matters is order: set your most important link as the primary link, and let line 4 of your bio point at that one only, e.g. '👇🏼 Latest food posts in the link'. If you swap the primary link, rewrite the CTA line too, or visitors will land somewhere your bio didn't promise.

faqEn.q: How many characters can an Instagram bio have?
faqEn.a: 150 characters. Each emoji counts as roughly 1–2 characters, and decorative symbols and line breaks count too, so an overstuffed bio gets cut off. This tool shows a live 'x/150' counter at the top — trim before you paste instead of discovering missing text after saving.

faqEn.q: Will fancy Unicode fonts break in my bio?
faqEn.a: It depends on how exotic the font is. Common styles (bold, italic, fullwidth) render fine on mainstream phones; very rare decorative glyphs may show as boxes on older Android devices. Preview your bio in the tool first, and when in doubt use classic symbols like ★✦ that almost never break. The site's fancy-font tool is a good place to pick styles.

faqEn.q: My bio line breaks collapsed after saving. How do I fix it?
faqEn.a: Instagram usually deletes completely empty lines. Paste an invisible character ㅤ (U+3164) onto the blank lines so each one 'looks empty but technically contains a character', and the spacing survives. If plain Enter line breaks already stick for you, you don't need the invisible characters.

faqEn.q: Should a creator bio be written differently from a personal bio?
faqEn.a: Yes. A personal bio only needs 2–3 interests that represent you — it's not a CV. A creator or business bio should add your niche plus a contact line so first-time visitors instantly get what the account is about. The built-in 'Creator / Designer' template gives you that professional skeleton in one click.

faqEn.q: How many links can I put in my Instagram bio?
faqEn.a: Up to 5 on a regular account (a Meta One subscription allows more). Filling all five doesn't help by itself: visitors usually tap only the primary link they see first. Decide which link matters most, set it as primary, and let your bio's call-to-action line point at it; the rest are backups.

faqEn.q: What's the difference between a display name and an @ handle?
faqEn.a: The display name is the name line at the top of your bio: it can hold other languages, symbols and niche keywords, it's searchable, and it's cheap to rewrite. The @ handle is your account's unique ID — it sets your profile URL and how others mention you, and changing it breaks old links and mentions. This tool's first field is the display name; the @ handle lives in Instagram's settings, so plan them separately.

faqEn.q: Is a Threads bio also 150 characters?
faqEn.a: Yes, Threads bios share the same 150-character limit, so this tool's x/150 counter works for both. The difference is tone: Threads reads more conversational than Instagram, so keep the same skeleton but rewrite the role line like you're talking to a friend — a polished IG bio pasted as-is looks stiff there.

faqEn.q: My bio is over 150 characters and gets cut off. What do I trim first?
faqEn.a: Trim in this order: repeated decorative symbols first, then the city/tag line, then filler words in the call to action — and touch the name and role lines last, because those two decide whether someone follows you. Get the tool's counter to 150 or under before you paste, instead of discovering the ending was eaten afterwards.

guideZh.h: IG、Threads 個人檔案的特殊符號怎麼用？
guideZh.p: 在上方搜尋框輸入關鍵字（例如：愛心、星星、箭頭），或直接瀏覽分類，點一下符號即自動複製。接著貼到 IG 個人檔案、精選名稱或 Threads 貼文即可。IG、Threads 對 Unicode 特殊符號相容度很高，極少數舊款手機可能把罕見符號顯示成方框，換一個常見符號就好。

guideZh.h: 遊戲暱稱加特殊符號，有什麼要注意？
guideZh.p: 多數手遊暱稱接受 ★ ♪ ✿ ❀ 這類常見符號，但部分遊戲會擋下太罕見的字元或判定為非法字元。建議先用常用符號組合，進遊戲實際測試能正常顯示再定案；另外暱稱有字數上限，符號太多可能被截斷。

guideZh.h: 日系花樣符號、標題裝飾框怎麼排？
guideZh.p: ♡・゜・。這類日系花紋適合放在貼文標題前後當裝飾，例如「♡・゜・本日穿搭・゜・♡」。本站收錄括號、框線、分隔線分類，可以把多個符號組合起來，先在本頁拼好再一次複製，貼文排版一次到位。

guideZh.h: 符號貼上後變成方框 □ 或問號怎麼辦？
guideZh.p: 這表示該裝置的字型沒有收錄這個字元（缺字），不是複製失敗。解法是換一個更常見的符號：愛心、星星、箭頭、音符這類基本符號幾乎所有手機和電腦都支援；越冷門的符號，缺字機率越高。

guideZh.h: 限動、貼文的「分隔線」怎麼挑才好看？
guideZh.p: 本站「線條與分隔」「分隔線與邊框」兩個分類就是為這個準備的。限動文字上下適合短裝飾線（例如 ⋆ ˚｡⋆），貼文段落之間適合長一點的虛線或波浪線。一個實用提醒：IG 自介只有 150 個字元，符號、空格、換行全部都算，一條裝飾線可能佔掉十幾個字元——建議在本頁先把整段拼好、數好字數，再一次複製貼上，避免貼上後才發現被截斷。

guideZh.h: 數字圈圈 ①②③：鍵盤打不出來的序號這樣拿
guideZh.p: ① 到 ⑳ 是 Unicode 的「帶圈數字」（U+2460 起），鍵盤本來就打不出來，複製貼上是最正規的用法。本站「數字與序號」分類一次收齊 ①–⑳、羅馬數字 Ⅰ–Ⅹ 和上標 ⁰–⁹，適合教學步驟、排行榜、注意事項的編號。進階用法：在 Word 用「插入 → 符號」也能找到它們；但要注意超過 20 就沒有帶圈數字了，長清單改用一般數字。另外螢幕閱讀器可能會把 ① 念成「circled one」，無障礙考量上重要資訊別只靠圈圈數字傳達。

guideZh.h: 箭頭＋項目符號：讓 Threads 分點清單更好讀
guideZh.p: Threads 貼文沒有粗體也沒有項目符號功能，想分點只能靠符號排版。本站「箭頭符號」「項目與標記」「打勾與叉號」三個分類就是解法：每行開頭放 ➤、✓ 或 •，一眼就是清單。實戰建議：一行只講一個重點、清單別超過五點、同一篇貼文只用一種開頭符號；混用全形半形符號容易在手機上對不齊，選定一種風格就貫徹到底。

faqZh.q: 特殊符號複製到 IG，會顯示不出來嗎？
faqZh.a: 絕大多數情況下可以。IG、Threads、LINE 都完整支援 Unicode，愛心、星星、箭頭這類常用符號在 iPhone 和 Android 都能正常顯示；只有極冷門的符號在舊裝置上可能變成方框。

faqZh.q: 這些特殊符號可以用在遊戲 ID 或暱稱嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以，但要看遊戲規定。多數手遊接受常見符號，少數會擋罕見字元；建議先用 ★ ♪ ✿ 等熱門符號測試，確認顯示正常再正式使用。

faqZh.q: iPhone 內建鍵盤打不出特殊符號怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: iPhone 鍵盤本來就沒有特殊符號區，這正是這類工具存在的理由：在本站點一下符號即複製，再貼到任何 App，不需要安裝額外鍵盤。

faqZh.q: 特殊符號和 emoji 有什麼不一樣？
faqZh.a: 特殊符號是純文字字元（Unicode），在任何字型下都顯示同一種樣式、不會變色，也不會被平台自動轉成圖片；emoji 則是彩色圖形，在不同手機上長相可能不同。想要風格統一的排版，特殊符號更可靠。

faqZh.q: 複製特殊符號要錢嗎？需要註冊嗎？
faqZh.a: 完全免費，不需註冊。點一下即複製，全程在瀏覽器端完成，不會上傳任何內容。

faqZh.q: 特殊符號貼到 LINE，會跑版或變很小嗎？
faqZh.a: LINE 完整支援 Unicode，貼上不會亂碼。但 LINE 的字型把某些裝飾符號畫得比較小，重要資訊（時間、地點、金額）建議用 ★ → ✓ 這類筆畫清楚的常用符號。不確定的組合，先傳給自己或只開一個人的測試群組看一眼再發。

faqZh.q: ①②③ 貼到 Word、Excel、PPT 能正常顯示和列印嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以。Office 全系列完整支援 Unicode，顯示、列印、轉 PDF 都正常。唯一要注意的是排序：Excel 會把 ① 當成文字而不是數字，沒辦法直接按 1、2、3 的數值排序；需要排序的表格，建議另外留一欄純數字。

faqZh.q: 分隔線裝飾會吃掉 IG 自介的字數嗎？
faqZh.a: 會。IG 自介上限 150 個字元，符號、空格、換行全部都算在內，一條裝飾分隔線可能佔掉十幾個字元。排版時先把整段在本頁拼好，數好字數再貼；如果字數爆了，優先刪裝飾線、保留聯絡資訊。

faqZh.q: 為什麼同一個符號，在朋友手機上看起來不太一樣？
faqZh.a: 特殊符號是純文字，長相由每支手機、每台電腦的字型決定，iOS、Android、Windows 畫出來的細節本來就略有不同——但它永遠是文字，不會像 emoji 那樣變色或變成圖片。想要所有人看到完全一樣的樣子，只有截圖成圖片一途。

guideEn.h: How do I use these symbols on Instagram and Threads?
guideEn.p: Type a keyword (e.g. heart, star, arrow) in the search box or browse the categories, then click a symbol to copy it instantly. Paste it into your Instagram bio, highlight names, or Threads posts. Instagram and Threads support Unicode symbols well; very rare symbols may show as boxes on older phones—just pick a more common one.

guideEn.h: Can I use symbols in game nicknames?
guideEn.p: Most mobile games accept common symbols like ★ ♪ ✿ ❀, but some block rare characters as invalid. Test your nickname in-game first with popular symbols, and keep it short—nicknames have character limits and long symbol strings may get cut off.

guideEn.h: How do I build decorative Japanese-style frames?
guideEn.p: Combine ornaments like ♡・゜・ around your headings, for example "♡・゜・Today's outfit・゜・♡". This page includes brackets, borders, and divider categories—compose your decoration here, copy it once, and paste it into your post.

guideEn.h: A symbol pastes as a box □ or question mark. What now?
guideEn.p: That means the device's font doesn't include the character (a missing glyph), not a copy failure. Switch to a more common symbol: hearts, stars, arrows, and music notes render on virtually every phone and computer, while obscure symbols are more likely to break.

guideEn.h: How do I pick divider lines for Stories and posts?
guideEn.p: The "Lines & Dividers" and "Dividers & Borders" categories exist for exactly this. Short decorative lines (like ⋆ ˚｡⋆) suit the top and bottom of Story text, while longer dashes or wavy lines suit breaks between post paragraphs. One practical note: an Instagram bio allows only 150 characters, and symbols, spaces, and line breaks all count — a single decorative divider can eat a dozen or more characters. Compose the whole block here, count the characters, then copy and paste in one go.

guideEn.h: Circled numbers ①②③: grabbing sequence numbers your keyboard can't type
guideEn.p: ① through ⑳ are Unicode "enclosed numbers" (starting at U+2460) — no keyboard types them, so copy-paste is the proper way to use them. The "Numbers & Sequences" category collects ①–⑳, Roman numerals Ⅰ–Ⅹ, and superscripts ⁰–⁹ in one place, perfect for tutorial steps, rankings, and numbered notes. Power users: Word's Insert → Symbol menu has them too. Note there is no circled number past 20, so long lists should use plain digits. Also, screen readers may announce ① as "circled one" — don't rely on circled numbers alone for critical information.

guideEn.h: Arrows + bullets: making Threads lists scannable
guideEn.p: Threads posts have no bold or bullet-list formatting, so symbols are your only layout tool. The "Arrows", "Bullets & Markers", and "Checks & Crosses" categories are the answer: start each line with ➤, ✓, or • and it reads as a list instantly. Practical tips: one point per line, no more than five items, and stick to a single opener symbol per post. Mixing full-width and half-width symbols can misalign on phones — pick one style and commit.

faqEn.q: Will copied symbols display correctly on Instagram?
faqEn.a: In almost all cases, yes. Instagram, Threads, and LINE fully support Unicode; common symbols like hearts, stars, and arrows render fine on iPhone and Android. Only very obscure symbols may appear as boxes on older devices.

faqEn.q: Can I use these symbols in my game ID?
faqEn.a: Yes, depending on the game. Most mobile games accept common symbols, though a few block rare characters. Start with popular ones like ★ ♪ ✿, test in-game, then finalize.

faqEn.q: My iPhone keyboard has no symbol section. What should I do?
faqEn.a: That's normal—the iPhone keyboard doesn't include special symbols. Click any symbol on this page to copy it, then paste into any app. No extra keyboard app needed.

faqEn.q: What's the difference between symbols and emoji?
faqEn.a: Symbols are plain text characters (Unicode) that render in a single style everywhere and never turn into images. Emoji are colorful graphics that can look different on each phone. For consistent styling, symbols are more reliable.

faqEn.q: Is copying symbols free? Do I need an account?
faqEn.a: Completely free, no sign-up required. One click copies the symbol, everything runs in your browser, and nothing is uploaded.

faqEn.q: Will symbols break the layout or shrink in LINE?
faqEn.a: LINE fully supports Unicode, so pasting won't garble anything. But LINE's font renders some decorative symbols quite small — use clear, common symbols like ★ → ✓ for critical info (time, place, price). Unsure about a combo? Send it to yourself or a one-person test group first.

faqEn.q: Do ①②③ display and print correctly in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint?
faqEn.a: Yes. Office apps fully support Unicode, so display, printing, and PDF export all work. The one caveat is sorting: Excel treats ① as text, not as the number 1, so you can't sort by numeric value — keep a separate plain-number column if you need to sort.

faqEn.q: Do decorative dividers eat into my Instagram bio character limit?
faqEn.a: Yes. The bio cap is 150 characters, and symbols, spaces, and line breaks all count — one decorative divider can take a dozen or more. Compose the full block here, check the count, then paste; if you're over, cut dividers first and keep your contact info.

faqEn.q: Why does the same symbol look slightly different on my friend's phone?
faqEn.a: Symbols are plain text — their exact look comes from each device's font, so iOS, Android, and Windows render slightly different details. But a symbol is always text: it never gets recolored or converted into an image the way emoji do. The only way everyone sees pixel-identical results is a screenshot.

guideZh.p: Emoji 最好用在三個地方：標題開頭當視覺錨點（例：🔥 本週最熱）、列表項目符號（每行一個 ✅ 讓重點好掃）、文末行動呼籲（👇🏼 連結在這裡）。一篇貼文 3～6 個最剛好，太多會讓版面雜亂、看起來像垃圾訊息。本工具的「連發組合」可以直接整組複製，貼到限動文字框就能用。

guideZh.h: 電腦上找不到 emoji？三種快速複製法
guideZh.p: Windows 按 Win + .（句號）叫出 emoji 面板；Mac 按 Control + Command + 空白鍵；或直接在本工具用中文關鍵字搜尋（例：打「哭」就找到 😭）。搜到點一下就複製完成，貼到 LINE、Discord、IG 全都通用，免安裝任何東西。

guideZh.h: 為什麼同一個 emoji 在別人的手機長得不一樣？
guideZh.p: Emoji 的長相是各家系統自己畫的（Apple、Google、三星畫風都不同），而且新 emoji 要新版系統才看得到，對方手機太舊會顯示方框或「?」。傳達重要訊息的符號（如 ✅⚠️）盡量用 Unicode 6.0 以前的老字，支援度最高、最不會出錯。

guideZh.h: 搜尋不到想要的 emoji？三招找法
guideZh.p: 先打中文關鍵字搜尋，例如打「感動」找 🥹、打「咖啡」找 ☕、打「台灣」找 🇹🇼；搜不到就換同義詞（「開心」換成「笑」或「喜歡」），因為每個 emoji 掛的關鍵字有限。還找不到就直接按分類瀏覽：本站分 常用、表情、手勢、愛心、人物、動物、自然、餐飲、活動、旅行、物件、符號、旗幟共 13 類，點分類標籤就能整批掃過，比一個一個翻鍵盤快得多。

guideZh.h: 精選情境組合包怎麼用：10 組現成情緒直接貼
guideZh.p: 本站有 10 組精選情境組合包，例如優雅崩潰 🫠☕️✨、社畜下班 🏃‍♂️💨💼🍻、派對慶祝 🎉🥂✨🥳、被可愛到 🥺🐾💖、放鬆夜晚 🌧️☕️📖。點一下就整組複製，適合放在貼文開頭當情緒定調，或放在文末當收尾。組合是固定整組，貼上後可以自行刪掉不要的單顆；如果只想要其中一顆，改到下方分類區點單顆複製就好。

guideZh.h: 貼文前先算字數：一個 emoji 在 IG 計數裡算 2 字
guideZh.p: IG 簡介上限 150 字、貼文 2200 字，而 IG 的計數方式把一個 emoji 算成 2 字（本站字數計數器的 IG 列就是這樣算），國旗這類組合 emoji 佔位更大。裝飾用 emoji 一多很容易在不知不覺中超標：貼文前先用本站字數計數器檢查 IG 列，超過就先刪裝飾用的、留傳達意思的，順序是「意思優先、裝飾其次」。

faqZh.q: Emoji 複製貼上到 IG 簡介會變方框嗎？
faqZh.a: 彩色 emoji 在 IG 簡介通常正常顯示，變方框的多半是特殊符號或新版 emoji（對方手機系統太舊）。保險做法：先貼到自己的限動或傳給朋友測試；真的出問題就換成舊版通用款，如 ❤️⭐✅。

faqZh.q: 一個 emoji 算幾個字？會吃掉 IG 字數嗎？
faqZh.a: 大多數 emoji 算 1 個字，但膚色、性別、國旗這類「組合 emoji」可能算 2～4 個字；IG 簡介上限 150 字、貼文 2200 字。貼完後看平台顯示的字數計數，超過就先刪幾個裝飾用的。

faqZh.q: 新出的 emoji 在舊手機上看不到怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 新 emoji 要搭配新版 iOS／Android 才有圖，舊系統只會顯示「?」或方框。如果受眾可能用舊手機，避開近兩年新出的 emoji，改用存在十年以上的經典款，如 😂❤️👍🔥。

faqZh.q: Emoji 用在商業貼文、廣告文案會有版權問題嗎？
faqZh.a: Unicode emoji 本身沒有版權，但「長相」是各系統畫的：在自己手機打字使用通常沒問題；若把 Apple／Google 的 emoji 圖檔拿去做 Logo 或商品販售，就可能踩到各家的使用條款。商業用途建議用文字形式直接打，而非下載圖檔。

faqZh.q: 搜尋打了關鍵字卻沒結果怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 先換同義詞再搜一次，例如「難過」換成「哭」或「感動」；或直接按分類標籤瀏覽（表情、手勢、愛心等 13 類）。另一個辦法是直接把 emoji 字元本身貼進搜尋框，本站搜尋也認 emoji 字元。若是近兩年才出的新 emoji，舊系統鍵盤可能根本還沒有，建議改用經典款代替。

faqZh.q: 情境組合包可以只複製其中一個 emoji 嗎？
faqZh.a: 組合包點一下是整組複製，不能只取其中一顆。做法有兩種：貼上後把不要的刪掉；或直接到下方分類區找到那顆單獨點一下複製。常搭的組合也可以複製後存進手機記事本，下次直接貼。

faqZh.q: 為什麼國旗 emoji 在某些地方顯示成 TW 兩個字母？
faqZh.a: 國旗 emoji 其實是由兩個「區域指示字母」組成的，裝置要支援國旗渲染才會顯示成旗幟；不支援的系統（例如部分舊版 Windows 或瀏覽器）就會直接顯示字母碼，如 TW、JP。不是你複製錯了，換一台新一點的手機或瀏覽器通常就正常；非換不可時，改用文字寫「台灣」最保險。

faqZh.q: 「最近使用」裡的 emoji 為什麼不見了？
faqZh.a: 最近使用存在你這台裝置的瀏覽器裡（最多留 12 個），清除瀏覽資料、換瀏覽器、換裝置或用無痕模式都會消失。這是本機紀錄，不會跟著帳號走。常用組合建議複製後存進手機記事本或常用語，才不會換手機就重找。

guideEn.h: Where to put emoji in IG Stories and Threads posts: 3 spots that work
guideEn.p: Emoji work best in three places: the start of a headline as a visual anchor (e.g. 🔥 this week's hottest), as list bullets (one ✅ per line so key points scan easily), and after your call to action (👇🏼 link here). Three to six per post is the sweet spot — more than that clutters the layout and looks spammy. This tool's combo packs copy as a whole set, ready to paste into a Story text box.

guideEn.h: Can't find emoji on your computer? Three fast ways to copy them
guideEn.p: On Windows press Win + . (period) to open the emoji panel; on Mac press Control + Command + Space. Or just search this tool with a keyword (type "cry" to find 😭) — one click copies it, then paste into LINE, Discord, or Instagram. No installation needed.

guideEn.h: Why does the same emoji look different on someone else's phone?
guideEn.p: Each system draws its own emoji style (Apple, Google, and Samsung all look different), and new emoji only render on up-to-date systems — older phones show a box or "?". For symbols that must be understood (✅⚠️), stick to pre-Unicode-6.0 classics with the widest support.

guideEn.h: Can't find the emoji you want? Three search tricks
guideEn.p: Search with a Chinese or English keyword first — type "touched" for 🥹, "coffee" for ☕, or "Taiwan" for 🇹🇼. If nothing matches, try a synonym ("happy" → "smile" or "love"), since each emoji only carries a few keywords. Still stuck? Browse by category: this tool groups everything into 13 categories — Popular, Faces, Gestures, Hearts, People, Animals, Nature, Food, Activities, Travel, Objects, Symbols, and Flags — so scanning a whole category beats flipping through a keyboard one by one.

guideEn.h: How to use the mood combo packs: 10 ready-made feelings, paste as a set
guideEn.p: This tool ships 10 curated combo packs, such as Elegant Collapse 🫠☕️✨, Off Work 🏃‍♂️💨💼🍻, Party Time 🎉🥂✨🥳, So Cute 🥺🐾💖, and Cozy Night 🌧️☕️📖. One click copies the whole set — drop it at the start of a post to set the mood, or at the end as a sign-off. Combos copy as a fixed set; trim unwanted pieces after pasting, or copy a single emoji from the category grid below if you only need one.

guideEn.h: Check the character count before posting: Instagram counts one emoji as 2 characters
guideEn.p: Instagram bios cap at 150 characters and captions at 2,200, and Instagram's counting treats one emoji as 2 characters (this site's character counter uses the same rule for its Instagram row) — flag and compound emoji take up even more room. Decorative emoji add up fast: check the Instagram row in this site's counter before posting, and if you're over, cut decorations first and keep the ones that carry meaning.

faqEn.q: Will pasted emoji turn into boxes in my Instagram bio?
faqEn.a: Color emoji usually render fine; boxes come from rare symbols or brand-new emoji on outdated phones. Test by posting to your own Story or sending to a friend first — if it breaks, swap in universal classics like ❤️⭐✅.

faqEn.q: How many characters does one emoji count as?
faqEn.a: Most emoji count as one character, but compound emoji (skin tones, genders, flags) can count as 2–4. Instagram bios cap at 150 characters and captions at 2,200. Paste first, check the platform's counter, and trim decorations if you're over.

faqEn.q: What if new emoji don't show on older phones?
faqEn.a: New emoji need a current iOS or Android to render; older systems show "?" or a box. If your audience may be on old phones, avoid emoji released in the last couple of years and use decade-old classics like 😂❤️👍🔥.

faqEn.q: Can I use emoji in commercial posts and ads?
faqEn.a: Unicode emoji themselves aren't copyrighted, but each platform's artwork is: typing emoji directly on your phone is generally fine, while downloading Apple or Google's emoji images for logos or merchandise can violate their terms. For commercial use, type emoji as text rather than reusing image files.

faqEn.q: I typed a keyword but got no results. What now?
faqEn.a: Try a synonym first — "sad" → "cry" or "touched" — or browse by category tab (Faces, Gestures, Hearts, and 10 more). You can also paste the emoji character itself into the search box; this tool's search matches emoji characters too. If it's an emoji released in the last couple of years, older keyboards may not have it yet — swap in a classic instead.

faqEn.q: Can I copy just one emoji from a combo pack?
faqEn.a: Combo packs copy as a whole set, not one piece at a time. Either paste the set and delete the ones you don't want, or find the single emoji in the category grid below and click it to copy. If you reuse a combo often, save the pasted set in your phone's notes so you don't have to hunt for it again.

faqEn.q: Why does a flag emoji show up as two letters like TW in some places?
faqEn.a: A flag emoji is really two "regional indicator" letters put together, and the device has to support flag rendering to draw the flag. Systems without that support (some older Windows versions or browsers, for example) just show the letter code, like TW or JP. Nothing went wrong with your copy — a newer phone or browser usually fixes it, and writing the country name out in words is the safest fallback.

faqEn.q: Why did my recently used emoji disappear?
faqEn.a: Recently used emoji live in this device's browser storage (up to 12 entries), so clearing browsing data, switching browsers or devices, or using incognito mode wipes them. They don't follow your account. Save combos you reuse into your phone's notes or text shortcuts so a new phone doesn't mean starting over.

guideZh.h: 什麼是顏文字？
guideZh.p: 顏文字（Kaomoji）是用標點符號與文字拼成的表情，不用轉頭就能看懂，例如 (´・ω・`)。源自日本 BBS 文化，比西方的 :-) 更早流行，至今仍是 Threads、IG、Discord 上愛用的可愛表達方式。

guideZh.h: 顏文字怎麼複製到 IG / Threads？
guideZh.p: 點一下顏文字即自動複製，開啟 App 貼上即可。顏文字由純文字組成，任何平台、任何裝置顯示都一致，不會有 Emoji 在不同系統長得不一樣的問題。

guideZh.h: 顏文字有哪些情緒分類？
guideZh.p: 本站收錄開心、委屈、哭泣、搞笑、生氣、害羞、驚訝等多種情緒分類，可以用關鍵字搜尋，也能把常用的加入收藏，隨時一鍵複製。

guideZh.h: 哀居限時動態、Threads 回文：顏文字這樣放才好看
guideZh.p: IG 限時動態用「打字」功能貼上顏文字後，先把字級拉大、避開上下邊緣的安全區，顏文字才不會被頭像和回覆框擋住。Threads 回文則建議把顏文字放在句尾、單獨一行，避免跟文字擠在同一行被自動換行切斷。這兩個場景都適合本站一鍵複製：點一下自動複製，切換到 App 貼上即可。

guideZh.h: 手機打顏文字太慢？設成輸入法捷徑一鍵打出
guideZh.p: 重度使用者不需要每次都來複製：iOS 到「設定→一般→鍵盤→文字取代」，把輸入碼設成例如 kk、cry，對應的內容貼上常用顏文字；Android 的 Gboard 在「個人字典」加捷徑也一樣。設好之後在 LINE、IG、Threads、Dcard 打字時輸入捷徑碼就會自動展開，任何 App 都能用。

guideZh.h: 顏文字在 Android 上變成方框、排版跑掉怎麼辦
guideZh.p: 看到方框 □ 代表目前的字型缺少那個字元，不是顏文字壞掉：換一套字型通常就解決，真的不行就改用常見標點組成的顏文字，任何裝置都支援。左右不對稱、眼睛歪一邊，多半是全形半形字元混用造成的，從本站點選複製的版本都經過整理，比自己手打組合更穩。

faqZh.q: 顏文字和 Emoji 有什麼不同？
faqZh.a: 顏文字是純文字符號拼成的表情，任何裝置顯示都一致；Emoji 是圖片字元，在 iPhone 和 Android 上長相不同，有時還會顯示成方框。

faqZh.q: 顏文字在 iPhone 上會變成亂碼嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會。顏文字只用到常見的標點與文字，iOS、Android 和電腦都能正常顯示。

faqZh.q: 顏文字可以用在遊戲 ID 或暱稱嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以，但部分遊戲會擋特殊符號；如果被擋，可以改用本站的花式風格暱稱產生器或 Unicode 特殊字體轉換器。

faqZh.q: 顏文字複製是免費的嗎？
faqZh.a: 免費，一鍵複製，不需註冊。

faqZh.q: 顏文字貼到 LINE 對話框會變形嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會變形，但 LINE 的訊息字級比較小，太長的顏文字在手機上容易被換行切開、變成兩行。建議選擇短版顏文字，或把顏文字和文字分行貼，排版最穩。

faqZh.q: 顏文字可以用在 IG 精選名稱或 Threads 個人檔案簡介嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以。IG 精選名稱最多 16 個字，挑短一點的顏文字塞進去剛好；Threads 簡介和 IG 個人檔案簡介都支援純文字顏文字，不會像 Emoji 那樣被系統重新渲染，iPhone 和 Android 看到的一模一樣。

faqZh.q: 遊戲暱稱有字數限制，顏文字太長放不下怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 遊戲暱稱通常限制 6 到 12 個字，先從短版顏文字挑起；如果連短版都被擋，代表該遊戲擋特殊字元，這時改用本站的「空白ID產生器」或花式暱稱工具會更適合。

guideEn.h: What are kaomoji?
guideEn.p: Kaomoji are emoticons built from punctuation and text, readable without tilting your head, like (´・ω・`). Born in Japanese BBS culture, they remain a beloved cute expression on Threads, Instagram, and Discord.

guideEn.h: How to copy kaomoji to Instagram or Threads?
guideEn.p: Tap any kaomoji to copy it automatically, then paste it into the app. Because kaomoji are plain text, they look identical on every platform and device.

guideEn.h: Using Kaomoji in Instagram Stories and Threads Replies
guideEn.p: In Instagram Stories, paste the kaomoji with the text tool, then enlarge the font and keep it away from the top and bottom safe zones so profile icons and reply bars don't cover it. In Threads replies, place the kaomoji at the end of your sentence on its own line so auto line-wrapping never cuts it in half. Tap any kaomoji here to copy it instantly, then switch to the app and paste.

guideEn.h: Save Frequently Used Kaomoji as Keyboard Shortcuts
guideEn.p: Heavy users don't need to copy every time: on iOS go to Settings > General > Keyboard > Text Replacement and map a short code like kk or cry to your favorite kaomoji; on Android add shortcuts in Gboard's personal dictionary. Once set, typing the shortcut expands to the kaomoji in LINE, Instagram, Threads, or any app.

faqEn.q: How are kaomoji different from emoji?
faqEn.a: Kaomoji are plain-text emoticons that look the same everywhere. Emoji are image characters that render differently on iPhone and Android, and sometimes show as boxes.

faqEn.q: Will kaomoji break on iPhone?
faqEn.a: No. Kaomoji only use common punctuation and letters, which display correctly on iOS, Android, and desktop.

faqEn.q: Is it free?
faqEn.a: Yes. One-tap copy, no sign-up required.

faqEn.q: Do kaomoji break or wrap strangely when pasted into chat apps?
faqEn.a: They don't deform, but long kaomoji may wrap mid-face in small chat bubbles. Use a short kaomoji or paste it on its own line for the most stable layout.

faqEn.q: Why do some kaomoji show as boxes on Android?
faqEn.a: A box means the current font is missing that character, not that the kaomoji is broken. Switching fonts usually fixes it; otherwise choose kaomoji made of common punctuation, which every device supports.

guideZh.h: IG 英文字體怎麼換？

guideZh.h: 花式字體會變成亂碼或方框嗎？

guideZh.h: IG 自我介紹排版：特殊字體＋現成英文短句直接套

guideZh.h: 顛倒翻轉字怎麼玩？一句話讓留言區炸鍋
guideZh.p: 點「🙃 顛倒翻轉字」風格，輸入的英文會變成上下顛倒的樣子（hello 變 ɥǝllo），非常適合留言、限動或 Threads 貼文開場。注意它只轉換英文字母，中文和數字不受影響；極少數舊字型顯示不完整時，改用粗體或全形即可。

guideZh.h: 哥德體、雙線空心體、手寫花體：怎麼選才不會變方框
guideZh.p: 相容性由高到低大致是：全形、粗體、斜體、圓圈、刪除線（幾乎所有裝置都支援）＞ 手寫花體、哥德體、雙線空心體（舊 Android 或部分字型可能顯示方框）。正式場合或要傳給很多人看時，選前段風格最保險；想追求造型感，貼出前先用另一支手機確認一次。

faqZh.q: 特殊字體在 iPhone / Android 都看得到嗎？

faqZh.q: IG 名字用特殊字體會被鎖帳號嗎？

faqZh.q: 特殊字體可以轉換中文嗎？

faqZh.q: 字體轉換要錢嗎？

faqZh.q: 遊戲暱稱可以用特殊字體嗎？
faqZh.a: 大多數手遊會擋掉 Unicode 裝飾字，轉好貼進暱稱欄若顯示異常或被拒絕，就是該遊戲不支援。想做隱形或造型暱稱，改用本站的「空白ID產生器」或暱稱工具成功率更高。

faqZh.q: Threads 的名字和貼文能用特殊字體嗎？

faqZh.q: 一次可以轉換幾個字？
faqZh.a: 本站輸入框上限 80 個字元，足夠應付簡介、標題和短句；長文案建議分段轉換再拼起來。

guideEn.h: How do fancy fonts work?
guideEn.p: Fancy fonts do not change the actual font. They swap Latin letters for look-alike Unicode symbols, fullwidth characters, or styled alphabets (like 𝓪𝓫𝓬 or ａｂｃ). Because they are plain text, they display in Instagram, Threads, and Facebook bios and posts.

guideEn.h: How to change fonts on Instagram?
guideEn.p: Type English text on this page, tap a style to copy it, then paste it into your IG bio, post, or story text. Only Latin letters and numbers are converted.

guideEn.h: Fancy Fonts for Your IG Bio: Presets That Just Work

Tap one to fill the input, pick from 19 styles — bold, italic, script, gothic and more — then copy and paste into your bio. Keep it to two or three lines; too much decoration buries the point.

guideEn.h: Upside-Down Text: Flip a Sentence in One Click
guideEn.p: Choose the 🙃 Upside Down style and your English text flips vertically (hello becomes ɥǝllo) — perfect for comments, stories, or a Threads opener. It only converts Latin letters; if an old device can't render it, switch to bold or fullwidth.

faqEn.q: Do fancy fonts work on iPhone and Android?
faqEn.a: Common styles (bold, italic, fullwidth, script) work on both. Very rare decorative styles may show as boxes on some older devices.

faqEn.q: Will Instagram ban me for using fancy fonts?
faqEn.a: No. These are legitimate Unicode characters, not policy violations. Overly decorated names may just be harder to search for.

guideZh.h: 多音字與罕見字怎麼處理

guideZh.h: 低年級注音學習單：老師家長三分鐘備課
guideZh.p: 把課文貼進左側輸入框，右側 ruby 對照會逐字標出注音，先掃一遍多音字——行、重、長、得這類字一律取最常用讀音，正式教材務必人工校對一次。打開「字間空格」讓注音更好讀，再用「一鍵複製注音」把純注音文字貼去列印。單次上限 2000 字，長課文分段貼；動手前先看下方的未收錄字統計，罕見字會保留原字顯示。

guideZh.h: 看著 ruby 念出來：親子共讀與華語學習

faqZh.q: 中文轉注音是免費的嗎？需要註冊嗎？

faqZh.q: 轉出來的注音準確嗎？

faqZh.q: 可以做成沒有聲調符號的注音文嗎？

faqZh.q: 簡體中文也可以轉注音嗎？

guideEn.h: Worksheets in minutes: a routine for teachers and parents

guideEn.h: Read it aloud: ruby annotations as a pronunciation guide
guideEn.p: The character-by-character ruby display doubles as a read-aloud sheet: kids or Mandarin learners read the bopomofo above each character while a parent or teacher corrects the tones. Keep Tone marks ON while learning — tones carry meaning in Mandarin. Once fluent, switch tones off and quiz yourself with toneless bopomofo text. The four built-in sample sentences under the input box are ready-made practice material.

faqEn.q: Is the Chinese to bopomofo converter free? Do I need an account?

faqEn.q: How accurate are the bopomofo readings?

faqEn.q: Can I get bopomofo without tone marks?

faqEn.q: Does it work with Simplified Chinese?

nickname.titleZh: 花式風格暱稱產生器｜遊戲 ID、IG 帳號風格暱稱｜字研所 TextLab
nickname.descriptionZh: 一鍵產生文青、日系、可愛或極簡風格暱稱與遊戲 ID，搭配 Unicode 字體與特殊符號建立專屬名稱。
nickname.descriptionEn: Generate aesthetic usernames, gaming IDs and nickname ideas with Unicode fonts and decorative symbols.

guideZh.h: 遊戲暱稱的萬用公式：風格詞＋裝飾符號
guideZh.p: 好看的暱稱多半是「一個有畫面的詞＋兩側裝飾符號＋短尾英文」。先選風格詞（夜桜、霧眠、貓系、日系漢字都好用），再用特殊符號框起來，最後補一個短尾。例：「₍ᐢ.ˬ.ᐢ₎霧眠」或「夜桜𝕹𝖎𝖌𝖍𝖙」。產生器一次給幾十種組合，直接挑順眼的用。

guideZh.h: 遊戲 ID 字數限制與符號相容性
guideZh.p: 主流手遊暱稱多在 12–16 字以內，太長會被截斷。花式字體在多數遊戲都能顯示，但極冷門的裝飾字在舊手機或特定遊戲可能變方框。建議先把喜歡的暱稱複製到遊戲改名預覽框確認顯示正常，再買改名卡，避免花錢還看不到效果。

guideZh.h: IG 帳號名稱怎麼取才好被搜到
guideZh.p: IG 帳號名稱（username）限 30 字，只能用英文字母、數字、底線和句點。花式字體雖然好看卻無法被搜尋，正確做法是：帳號名稱放可搜尋的英文＋關鍵字，顯示名稱（name）再用花式字體或中文暱稱，兩邊分工不打架。

guideZh.h: 自己拼裝四格怎麼拼：開頭、名字前、名字後、結尾各留一格
guideZh.p: 工具的「自己拼裝」模式有開頭、名字前、名字後、結尾四格，每格可選一個符號或留空（∅）。原則是先放名字，再決定要不要兩側對稱裝飾；四格全塞符號會又長又亂，通常只填名字前後兩格就夠好看。拼完先看預覽整體長度，太長就先把開頭或結尾那格清掉，別急著縮名字。

guideZh.h: 遊戲、社群、公會三種用途先分流再取
guideZh.p: 隨機產生前先選用途。遊戲：優先看字數上限與會不會缺字，選常見裝飾；社群：顯示名稱可以放花式字體，帳號名稱只能用英文字母、數字、底線和句點，兩邊要分開想；公會：先定一套固定格式，例如全員名字前都放同一個公會標記，成員名字再各取各的，組隊列表一眼就認得出是同隊。

guideZh.h: 日系清新、可愛甜系、極簡質感三種風格差在哪
guideZh.p: 日系清新適合漢字詞加輕裝飾，例如夜桜、霧眠這類有畫面的詞配少量符號；可愛甜系適合顏文字配件與圓潤符號，適合社群與休閒遊戲；極簡質感是少符號、留白多，適合想低調但不想撞名的人。風格選錯不用重想，換一個風格按「再產生一組」，同一關鍵字多刷幾輪再挑。

faqZh.q: 為什麼暱稱貼到遊戲裡變成方框或問號？
faqZh.a: 代表該字元在遊戲字體裡缺字。常見風格（粗體、斜體、全形）在主流遊戲都能顯示；太冷門的裝飾字在部分遊戲或舊手機會變方框。解法是換一個風格再試，或改用 ★↘乂 這類幾乎不會缺字的特殊符號。

faqZh.q: 遊戲暱稱改名要花錢嗎？
faqZh.a: 多數遊戲首次改名免費，之後要買改名卡，價格依遊戲而定。改名前先把喜歡的暱稱複製到遊戲預覽框試貼，確認不缺字、沒被註冊再動手最保險。

faqZh.q: 暱稱一直顯示已有人使用怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 在原詞前後加底線、數字或句點，或換一種裝飾符號組合，幾乎都能繞過重複。例如「夜桜」被用走，可以試「夜桜_」、「₍夜桜₎」或「夜桜𝕏」。

faqZh.q: 花式字體可以用在 IG 帳號名稱嗎？
faqZh.a: 不行。IG 帳號名稱只能用英文字母、數字、底線和句點，花式字體貼進去會被擋。想在 IG 用花式字體，請放在顯示名稱（name）或個人簡介（bio），那裡沒有限制。

faqZh.q: 自己拼裝的暱稱太長，貼到遊戲被截斷怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 裝飾符號也佔字數。先把開頭或結尾那格改回留空（∅），還太長就把名字縮短——工具輸入上限是 12 字，名字本身越短，留給裝飾的空間越大。改完先貼到遊戲改名預覽框確認沒被截斷再存檔。

faqZh.q: 公會成員的暱稱要怎麼統一格式？
faqZh.a: 先約定固定位：例如名字前統一放公會標記、名字後留給個人發揮。用「自己拼裝」模式把名字前那格固定下來，每個人只換中間名字，就能整齊又不撞名。注意有些遊戲禁特殊符號，先拿一個成員的版本進遊戲測試能顯示再全員跟進。

faqZh.q: 隨機產生的暱稱都不喜歡，要一直重想關鍵字嗎？
faqZh.a: 不用。先換風格（日系清新、可愛甜系、極簡質感各刷一輪），再按「再產生一組」多看幾組；還是不合意就改用「自己拼裝」，直接鎖定你喜歡的符號組合，比一直換關鍵字快。

faqZh.q: 暱稱在自己手機好看，換到別台裝置符號長得不一樣？
faqZh.a: 那是字體差異，不是名字壞掉。顏文字與冷門裝飾在不同手機、不同遊戲字體下長相本來就不同。正式定案前，換一台裝置或請朋友截圖確認一次；要穩就選常見符號與粗體、斜體、全形這類幾乎不會缺字的風格。

guideEn.h: A formula for aesthetic gaming nicknames
guideEn.p: Most good-looking nicknames follow one pattern: a visual word plus decorative symbols on both sides plus a short English tail. Pick your vibe word first (moon, mist, sakura), frame it with symbols, then add a short suffix. The generator gives you dozens of combos to pick from.

guideEn.h: Character limits and symbol compatibility in games
guideEn.p: Most mobile games cap nicknames at 12-16 characters; longer names get cut off. Fancy Unicode fonts usually work, but very rare decorative glyphs can render as boxes on older devices or in specific games. Always paste into the rename preview first before spending a rename card.

guideEn.h: Make your Instagram handle discoverable
guideEn.p: Instagram usernames are limited to 30 characters and only allow letters, numbers, underscores, and periods. Fancy fonts look great but are not searchable, so put searchable keywords in the username and save the fancy styling for the display name and bio.

guideEn.h: Build your own: how to use the four slots
guideEn.p: The "Build your own" mode has four slots: Start, Before, After, and End. Each slot takes one symbol or stays blank (∅). Put your name in first, then decide whether to frame it symmetrically; filling all four slots usually looks cluttered. Filling just the Before and After slots is often enough. Check the preview length first — if it is too long, clear the Start or End slot before shortening your name.

guideEn.h: Pick the purpose first: gaming, social, or guild
guideEn.p: Choose a purpose before generating. For games, watch the character limit and missing-glyph risk, and prefer common decorations. For social profiles, remember the display name can use fancy fonts while the username only allows letters, numbers, underscores, and periods — plan them separately. For guilds, agree on one fixed format first, such as the same guild mark before every member's name, so the roster reads as one team at a glance.

guideEn.h: Japanese, Cute, or Minimal: what each style is for
guideEn.p: Japanese suits a visual word with light decoration, such as sakura or mist words with a few symbols. Cute suits kaomoji parts and rounded symbols, good for social profiles and casual games. Minimal uses few symbols and more whitespace, good for staying low-key without colliding with taken names. If a style feels wrong, switch styles and hit "Generate more" a few rounds with the same keyword instead of starting over.

faqEn.q: Why does my nickname show as boxes in games?
faqEn.a: The glyph is missing from the game's font. Common styles (bold, italic, fullwidth) work almost everywhere; very rare decorative fonts may show as boxes on some devices. Switch to another style or use classic decorative symbols like ★ which almost never break.

faqEn.q: Is renaming in games free?
faqEn.a: Usually the first rename is free, then you need a rename card, and prices vary by game. Paste your favorite nickname into the in-game preview first to check for boxes and availability.

faqEn.q: My nickname is already taken. What now?
faqEn.a: Add underscores, numbers, or periods around the word, or switch the decorative symbol framing - that almost always works around duplicates.

faqEn.q: Can I use fancy fonts in my Instagram username?
faqEn.a: No. Usernames only allow letters, numbers, underscores, and periods, so fancy fonts get rejected. Use them in your display name or bio instead, where there are no restrictions.

faqEn.q: My built nickname is too long and gets cut off in games. What do I do?
faqEn.a: Decorative symbols count toward the length too. Clear the Start or End slot back to blank (∅) first; if it is still too long, shorten the name itself — the tool caps input at 12 characters, so a shorter name leaves more room for decoration. Paste the result into the game's rename preview to confirm it is not cut off before saving.

faqEn.q: How should guild members format their nicknames consistently?
faqEn.a: Agree on a fixed slot first: for example, the same guild mark in the Before slot for everyone, with the name itself left to each member. Use "Build your own" mode to lock that slot, then only swap the middle name. Some games restrict special symbols, so test one member's version in-game before the whole guild follows.

faqEn.q: I don't like any of the random nicknames. Do I need a new keyword?
faqEn.a: No. Try each style first (Japanese, Cute, Minimal), then hit "Generate more" for more rounds with the same keyword. If nothing fits, switch to "Build your own" and lock in the symbol combination you like — that is faster than endlessly swapping keywords.

faqEn.q: My nickname looks fine on my phone but different on another device. Why?
faqEn.a: That is a font difference, not a broken name. Kaomoji and rare decorations render differently across phones and game fonts. Before finalizing, check it on another device or ask a friend for a screenshot; for the safest result, use common symbols and styles like bold, italic, or fullwidth that almost never go missing.

guideZh.h: 什麼是透明空白文字？
guideZh.p: 透明空白文字是由 Unicode 空白字元（如 U+3164 諺文填充字元、U+2800 點字空格）組成的「看不見的字」。它們佔據字元位置卻不顯示任何符號，可以在 IG、Threads、LINE、遊戲 ID 等不接受純空格的地方製造留白、分段或空白名稱。

guideZh.h: IG 精選動態的空白怎麼複製？
guideZh.p: 在本頁點一下空白字元卡片即自動複製，接著開啟 IG → 個人檔案 → 精選 → 編輯精選 → 在名稱欄位貼上即可。哀居精選名稱不接受一般空格，用 Unicode 空白字元就能做出乾淨的留白效果。

guideZh.h: 遊戲 ID 的空白名字怎麼打？
guideZh.p: 許多手遊的暱稱不允許純空格或全空白名字。複製本站的空白字元貼到遊戲 ID 欄位，即可做出隱形名字；如果某個字元被系統擋下，換另一種空白字元再試一次。

guideZh.h: LINE、Threads 排版換行，貼上會消失怎麼辦？

guideZh.h: 哀居精選封面空白名稱怎麼做？
guideZh.p: 想讓 IG 精選動態的名稱完全留白？在本頁複製一組 U+3164 空白字元，接著開啟 IG → 個人檔案 → 長按該精選 → 編輯精選 → 在名稱欄位貼上空白字元並儲存。哀居精選名稱不接受一般空格，但會把 Unicode 空白字元當成有效文字保留，做出乾淨的無字封面效果。

guideZh.h: 三種空白字元怎麼選？U+3164、U+2800、U+200B 差在哪？
guideZh.p: U+3164（諺文填充字元）幾乎不佔視覺寬度、最通用，適合 IG 精選名稱、遊戲 ID 這種「塞進名字裡」的場景；U+2800（點字空格）有固定寬度，適合 LINE、Threads 貼文的段落留白與換行排版；U+200B（零寬空格）完全隱形，但少數平台會把它當作空字串過濾掉，被擋下時就換 U+3164 再試。不知道選哪個，先從本站標示「通用」的卡片開始。

guideZh.h: IG 個人檔案簡介怎麼置中排版？
guideZh.p: IG 簡介編輯框會自動把文字靠左對齊，想做出置中效果：在文字前面貼上數個 U+2800 點字空格，利用它的固定寬度把文字往右推；換行處也用空白字元代替一般空格，避免送出時被吃掉。可以搭配本站的 IG 換行排版工具先預覽、再一次複製貼上。

faqZh.q: 空白複製後貼上，別人看得到嗎？
faqZh.a: 看不到任何符號，但字元確實存在。對方看到的是留白或空白名稱，這正是透明空白文字的用途。

faqZh.q: 為什麼我複製的空格在 IG 貼上會消失？
faqZh.a: 一般半形空格會被 IG 自動清除。本站提供的是 Unicode 特殊空白字元（如 U+3164、U+2800），系統會將它們視為有效字元而保留下來。

faqZh.q: iPhone 和 Android 都能用嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以。這幾種空白字元在 iOS、Android、Windows、macOS 的主流 App 都能正常顯示為留白；極少數老舊系統可能顯示為方框，換一種字元即可。

faqZh.q: 空白文字可以用在 Discord、LINE 名字嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以。Discord 暱稱、LINE 顯示名稱、Threads 個人檔案都接受這些 Unicode 空白字元，做法都是複製後貼上。

faqZh.q: 複製空白文字要錢嗎？需要註冊嗎？
faqZh.a: 完全免費，不需註冊。點一下卡片即複製，全程在瀏覽器端完成，不會上傳任何內容。

faqZh.q: 哀居精選名字可以全空白嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以。複製本站的 U+3164 空白字元，貼到精選的「編輯精選」名稱欄位即可。IG 不接受純空格，但 Unicode 空白字元會被視為有效字元而保留，名稱就會顯示為全空白。

faqZh.q: U+3164 跟 U+2800 貼到 IG 效果有什麼不同？
faqZh.a: U+3164 幾乎不佔視覺寬度，適合塞在名稱或 ID 裡做隱形效果；U+2800 有固定寬度，適合做段落留白或簡介置中排版。兩個在 IG 都能正常保留，看你的使用場景選擇。

faqZh.q: 空白文字會被平台偵測或封鎖嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會。這些都是合法的 Unicode 字元，不是外掛或漏洞。不過極少數遊戲或 App 會把零寬字元（U+200B）過濾掉，遇到時換成 U+3164 或 U+2800 通常就能解決。

guideEn.h: What is invisible text?
guideEn.p: Invisible text is made of Unicode blank characters (such as U+3164 Hangul Filler and U+2800 Braille Pattern Blank) that take up space without showing any glyph. Use them for spacing, line breaks, and empty usernames where regular spaces are stripped, including Instagram, Threads, LINE, and gaming IDs.

guideEn.h: How to make a blank Instagram highlight name?
guideEn.p: Tap a blank character card on this page to copy it, then open Instagram, go to your profile, edit a highlight, and paste it into the name field. Instagram removes normal spaces, but keeps these Unicode blank characters.

guideEn.h: How to make a blank Instagram highlight cover name?
guideEn.p: Want a highlight with no name at all? Copy a set of U+3164 blank characters on this page, then open Instagram → profile → long-press the highlight → Edit Highlight → paste the blank characters into the name field and save. Instagram rejects plain spaces but keeps Unicode blanks as valid text, giving you a clean nameless cover.

guideEn.h: U+3164 vs U+2800 vs U+200B: which blank character should I use?
guideEn.p: U+3164 (Hangul filler) is nearly zero-width and the most universal pick — ideal for highlight names and game IDs where the blank sits inside a name. U+2800 (braille pattern blank) has a fixed width, better for paragraph spacing and bio centering on LINE or Threads. U+200B (zero-width space) is fully invisible, but a few platforms filter it out as empty — if it gets stripped, switch to U+3164 and try again.

faqEn.q: Will others see the blank characters I paste?
faqEn.a: No visible glyph appears, but the characters are really there. Others see clean spacing or an empty name, which is exactly the point of invisible text.

faqEn.q: Why does a normal space disappear on Instagram?
faqEn.a: Instagram strips regular spaces. This page provides Unicode blank characters (like U+3164 and U+2800) that the system treats as valid characters and keeps.

faqEn.q: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
faqEn.a: Yes. These blank characters display as spacing in mainstream apps on iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS.

faqEn.q: Can my Instagram highlight name be completely blank?
faqEn.a: Yes. Copy U+3164 blank characters from this page and paste them into the highlight's Edit Highlight name field. Instagram won't accept plain spaces, but Unicode blanks count as valid characters, so the name renders as fully blank.

faqEn.q: What's the difference between U+3164 and U+2800 on Instagram?
faqEn.a: U+3164 is nearly zero-width, best for hiding inside names or IDs; U+2800 has a fixed width, better for paragraph spacing or centering your bio. Both are kept by Instagram — pick based on your use case.

deal.titleZh: 電商開團爆單文案機｜團購主・KOL 帶貨・防客訴規格一鍵生成｜字研所 TextLab
deal.descriptionZh: 專為電商賣家、團購主、KOL 帶貨設計的商業爆單文案引擎！自動試算現省金額與折扣、生成痛點急迫感、防客訴退換貨規格。
deal.titleEn: E-Commerce Group-Buy & Sales Copy Engine | TextLab Pro
deal.descriptionEn: Generate high-converting e-commerce group-buy copy, price calculation, and dispute-proof terms for Instagram, LINE, and Facebook.

guideZh.h: 開團文案黃金結構：價格錨點＋亮點＋截團，三段寫完就好
guideZh.p: 一篇會賣的開團文不用長，順序對就好：第一段先亮價格錨點——市售原價多少、這次開團價多少、現省多少，工具會自動算出折扣百分比，不用自己按計算機；第二段列 3 個必買亮點，只寫團友真正會在意的（省錢、省事、獨家）；第三段給截團時間與數量，限時限量寫清楚。把商品名、原價、開團價貼進本工具，選一種文案風格，一鍵生成就能貼到群組。

guideZh.h: LINE 群、IG、Threads 開團文怎麼分流：同一檔團，四種寫法
guideZh.p: 同一個商品，四個平台要四種語氣：LINE 群組用「正式公告版」——價格、方案、截團、下單須知一次寫齊，團友不用往上翻；IG 貼文用「粉絲推薦版」——口語推薦＋留言「+1」導私訊；IG 限動只放一句價格錨點＋連結；Threads 用「DM 私訊腳本」——貼文底端放留言鉤子，粉絲留言後自動私訊優惠碼，3 小時後再一則溫馨催單。先在工具裡選對風格，再貼到對應平台。

guideZh.h: 防客訴：下單須知先寫進文案，糾紛少一半
guideZh.p: 團購糾紛八成不是商品問題，是規則沒先講：截團後能不能取消、多久取貨、到貨日能不能保證、缺貨怎麼退。把這些寫進文案的「下單須知」，下單就等於同意規則，事後才有依據。注意：寫「售出概不退換」並不能排除瑕疵品依法該有的處理——有瑕疵、與描述不符，還是要處理。規則寫清楚、態度留彈性，才是長期開團的作法。

faqZh.q: 開團文案要寫多長？LINE 群和 IG 貼文一樣嗎？
faqZh.a: 不一樣。LINE 群組適合完整版：價格、亮點、截團、下單須知一次寫齊，因為團友會往上翻找規則；IG 貼文則要把價格錨點與懸念塞進前 125 字（之後會被折疊成「…更多」），亮點與須知放後面；限動只放一句話＋連結。本工具的四種風格就是按這個分流設計的，選對風格再貼。

faqZh.q: 「現省多少、打幾折」怎麼算才不會寫錯？
faqZh.a: 現省金額＝市售原價 − 開團價；折扣百分比＝現省金額 ÷ 市售原價。本工具輸入原價與開團價就會自動試算，文案裡的數字不會算錯。另一個常見地雷是把「市售價」灌水：請寫商品實際賣過的價格，虛構原價來襯托折扣，可能涉及廣告不實，別為了好看多寫。

faqZh.q: 團購下單須知一定要寫哪些項目？
faqZh.a: 至少五項：①截團時間 ②付款方式與期限 ③取貨／出貨時間 ④退換貨條件（瑕疵、尺寸不合、食品問題各怎麼處理）⑤缺貨、斷貨怎麼退費。寫進文案、下單即視為同意，事後有爭議才有白紙黑字可對。勾選本工具的防客訴選項，就能自動生成一段完整的下單須知。

faqZh.q: 團友喊單後棄單、已讀不回怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 事前防範勝於事後追討：文案裡先寫明棄單規則，例如結單後不接受取消、多次未取貨列入黑名單；催單則用本工具的 DM 私訊腳本——粉絲留言「+1」後先秒回優惠碼與連結，3 小時後再一則溫馨提醒（庫存倒數、截團時間），比在群組公開點名有效，也保留對話紀錄。

guideEn.h: The group-buy copy formula: price anchor + highlights + deadline
guideEn.p: A group-buy post that sells doesn't need to be long — it needs the right order. First, the price anchor: retail price, group price, and how much buyers save (this tool calculates the discount percentage for you). Second, three highlights buyers actually care about: saving money, saving effort, exclusivity. Third, the deadline and stock limit. Enter the product name, retail price, and group price, pick a style, and paste the result into your group.

guideEn.h: One deal, four versions: LINE group, IG post, IG Story, Threads
guideEn.p: The same deal needs a different voice per platform. Use the formal announcement version for LINE groups — price, terms, deadline, and ordering rules in one place so members can scroll up and find them. Use the fan-recommendation version for Instagram posts — conversational, with a "+1 in the comments" call to action that routes to DMs. Stories get one price-anchor line plus a link. Threads gets the DM script — a comment hook in the post, an instant DM with the discount code, and a gentle 3-hour follow-up nudge.

guideEn.h: Dispute-proof terms: put the ordering rules in the copy
guideEn.p: Most group-buy disputes aren't about the product — they're about rules nobody stated upfront: can orders be cancelled after the deadline, how long to pick up, whether delivery dates are guaranteed, what happens on stockouts. Put these in the ordering-terms section so ordering counts as agreeing to them. One caution: writing "no returns, no exceptions" does not waive your handling of defective or misdescribed items. Clear rules plus a reasonable attitude keep a group-buy running long-term.

faqEn.q: How long should group-buy copy be? Is LINE the same as Instagram?
faqEn.a: No. LINE groups suit the full version — price, highlights, deadline, and ordering terms in one message, since members scroll up to find the rules. Instagram posts need the price anchor and hook inside the first ~125 characters (the rest folds behind "…more"), with highlights and terms below. Stories get one line plus a link. This tool's four styles are built for exactly this split.

faqEn.q: How do I calculate "you save" and the discount percentage?
faqEn.a: Savings = retail price − group price; discount % = savings ÷ retail price. Enter both prices and the tool does the math, so the numbers in your copy are never wrong. One common trap: inflating the "retail price" to make the discount look bigger. Use the price the product actually sells for — a made-up anchor can count as misleading advertising.

faqEn.q: What must group-buy ordering terms cover?
faqEn.a: At least five things: ① order deadline ② payment method and cutoff ③ pickup / shipping timing ④ return and exchange rules (defects, wrong size, food issues) ⑤ how stockouts and refunds are handled. When the terms are in the copy, ordering counts as agreeing to them. Tick the dispute-proof options in this tool to auto-generate a complete terms block.

faqEn.q: What if a member claims an item and then ghosts?
faqEn.a: Prevention beats chasing: state the no-show rule in the copy — for example, no cancellations after the deadline, repeat no-shows go on a blocklist. For nudges, use this tool's DM script: an instant DM with the discount code and link when someone comments "+1", then a friendly reminder about 3 hours later (stock countdown, deadline). It converts better than public callouts and keeps a message record.
