swipe.titleEn: Viral Social Swipe File | Proven High-Converting Copy Templates | TextLab
swipe.descriptionEn: Proven high-converting copy templates for Instagram, Threads, and e-commerce group-buys. Copy and customize viral posts in seconds.

guideZh.h: 模板抄架構不抄句子：三個替換點讓爆款變成你的文
guideZh.p: 同一個模板幾百個人都在用，直接全文照貼最容易撞文、看起來也像機器人。正確用法是抄「骨架」留「血肉」：第一，把主詞換成你自己的真實情境——模板寫「職場」，你是團媽就改成帶團實況；第二，把數字換成真的——「改了 5 次草稿」這種細節必須是你發生過的事，編出來的數字讀者一看就假；第三，結尾問句改成你真的想聽的回答，不要留罐頭句。骨架相同沒關係，細節是你的，整篇就是你的原創。

guideZh.h: 三大分類怎麼選：選錯分類，語氣就全錯
guideZh.p: 文案庫目前有三個分類，對應三種完全不同的寫法。想衝互動選「Threads 破萬讚」：開頭要丟衝突或反常識觀點，結尾留一個開放問句讓人忍不住回；想賣貨選「團媽開團爆單」：價格對比與結單倒數是核心，少了這兩個就只是漂亮廢話；想經營氛圍選「IG 氛圍生活」：重點是畫面感與排版，文字要像在描述一張照片。先想清楚這篇的目的是互動、賣貨還是養粉，再選分類，不要看到順眼就套。

guideZh.h: 發文前四問檢查清單：通過了再按發佈
guideZh.p: 貼上模板、替換完之後，發佈前先問自己四個問題：一，開頭三秒能不能看懂在講什麼？看不懂就砍掉第一段重寫開頭；二，結尾問句是不是真的想聽回答？敷衍的「你怎麼看」不如不問；三，文裡的數字、價格、名額是不是真的？假數字被抓包一次，帳號信任就歸零；四，還有沒有殘留的大括號佔位符（例如 {原價}）？全文搜尋一次「{」確認清乾淨。發佈後半小時內守著留言區，第一時間回覆每一則留言，互動熱度就是這樣燒起來的。

faqZh.q: 直接複製模板發文，會不會被平台降觸及？
faqZh.a: 平台罰的是「重複內容」，不是「模板」。同一份模板原封不動被幾十個人同時發出，演算法可能判定為低品質重複內容；但只要照指南把主詞、數字、結尾問句換成你自己的真實經歷，結構相似、內容不同，就屬於正常創作。最忌諱的是什麼都不改、連錯字都一起抄——那不只可能被降觸及，被讀者發現還會丟信任。

faqZh.q: Threads 文案有字數限制嗎？模板會不會超長？
faqZh.a: Threads 單篇貼文上限是 500 字，超過就得拆成串文。文案庫的模板都控制在限制內，但你替換內容、加長故事後很容易超標，發佈前務必用本網站的字數計數器確認一次。如果超了，優先砍形容詞與重複的例子，不要砍開頭鉤子與結尾問句——那兩個才是決定互動的關鍵。

faqZh.q: 團購文案的價格、折扣數字可以寫誇張一點嗎？
faqZh.a: 不行。把不存在的原價寫成原價、把沒打過的折扣寫成折扣，都屬於廣告不實，依公平交易法可被公平會處罰，消費者也可以主張退貨求償。正確做法是只寫真實售價與真實折扣，截圖保留售價憑證；「現省」金額要用原價減團購價實際算出來，不要用感覺估。寫法上寧可保守一點，也不要為了衝單寫出之後無法兌現的承諾。

faqZh.q: 模板裡的 {原價}、{商品品名} 這種大括號要刪掉嗎？
faqZh.a: 要，而且要全部替換成真實內容再發。大括號是佔位符，提醒你這裡要填自己的資訊；直接帶著大括號發出去，等於告訴所有人「這篇是抄來的」，還會讓團友搞不清楚價格。發佈前用一個小習慣收尾：全文搜尋一次「{」，確認沒有任何佔位符殘留，再按發佈。

guideEn.h: Copy the structure, not the sentences: three swaps that make a template yours
guideEn.p: Hundreds of people can use the same template, so pasting it verbatim is the fastest way to look like a bot. Keep the skeleton and replace the flesh: first, swap the subject for your own real situation — if the template says 'office life' but you run a group buy, rewrite it around your group buy. Second, replace every number with a real one — details like 'revised the draft 5 times' only work if they actually happened to you; invented numbers read as fake. Third, rewrite the closing question into one you genuinely want answered, not a canned line. Same skeleton plus your own details equals your own original post.

guideEn.h: Pick the right category: the wrong category means the wrong tone
guideEn.p: The swipe file has three categories for three very different jobs. Pick 'Threads viral' when you want replies: lead with a conflict or counter-intuitive take and end with an open question people cannot resist answering. Pick 'group-buy bestsellers' when you want sales: the price comparison and the closing countdown are the core — without them it is just pretty filler. Pick 'IG cozy life' when you want atmosphere: the words should read like a description of a photo, and layout matters as much as wording. Decide the goal first — replies, sales, or vibe — then pick the category; do not grab whichever template looks nice.

guideEn.h: The four-question pre-post checklist: pass it before you hit publish
guideEn.p: After pasting a template and swapping in your details, ask four questions before publishing. One: can a stranger understand the point in the first three seconds? If not, rewrite the opening. Two: is the closing question one you actually want answered? A lazy 'what do you think?' is worse than no question. Three: are the numbers, prices, and stock counts real? One caught fake number costs you the account's trust. Four: are there any leftover brace placeholders like {original price}? Search the whole post for '{' to confirm. After publishing, stay in the comments for the first 30 minutes and reply to every comment — that is how early engagement gets built.

faqEn.q: Will posting a copied template hurt my reach?
faqEn.a: Platforms penalize duplicate content, not templates. If dozens of people post the same template word for word at the same time, the algorithm may treat it as low-quality repetition. But once you swap in your own subject, numbers, and closing question, the structure may be similar while the content is genuinely yours — that is normal creation. The worst move is changing nothing, typos included: that risks both reduced distribution and lost trust when readers notice.

faqEn.q: Does Threads have a character limit? Will the templates exceed it?
faqEn.a: A single Threads post allows up to 500 characters; anything longer must be split into a thread. The swipe-file templates all fit within the limit, but once you expand the story with your own details it is easy to go over, so check with this site's character counter before publishing. If you are over, cut adjectives and repeated examples first — never cut the opening hook or the closing question, because those two drive replies.

faqEn.q: Can I exaggerate prices or discounts in group-buy copy?
faqEn.a: No. Listing a fake original price or a discount you never offered is false advertising: in Taiwan it can draw a Fair Trade Commission penalty under the Fair Trade Act, and buyers can demand returns or compensation. Only state real selling prices and real discounts, keep screenshots as proof, and calculate 'you save' as the actual difference between the original price and the group price — never estimate by feel. When in doubt, write conservatively rather than promising something you cannot deliver.

faqEn.q: Do I need to remove placeholders like {original price} from the templates?
faqEn.a: Yes — replace every placeholder with your real information before posting. The braces mark spots where your own details go; publishing with them still in place tells everyone the post was copied, and leaves group members confused about the price. Finish with a small habit: search the whole post for '{' to confirm no placeholder remains, then hit publish.

localize.nameZh: 台灣用語與法規避雷器
localize.titleZh: 台灣用語與法規避雷器｜大陸用語轉正統繁體・衛福部廣告法規防罰鍰｜字研所 TextLab
localize.descriptionZh: 一鍵將大陸用語（質量、視頻、立馬等）轉為 100% 正統台灣繁體語感，同時自動掃描衛福部食品/化粧品廣告法規違規詞，替換合法詞省下 4 萬罰單。
localize.titleEn: Taiwan Voice & Ad Legal Sanitizer | Localize Copy & Compliance | TextLab
localize.descriptionEn: Clean mainland buzzwords into natural Taiwanese phrasing and detect illegal advertising claim terms to avoid regulatory fines.

guideZh.h: 支語從哪裡漏進來的：ChatGPT、小紅書、剪映字幕是三大來源
guideZh.p: 文案裡的大陸用語多半不是故意寫的，而是從三個地方漏進來的：ChatGPT 草稿（訓練語料以簡體為主）、小紅書抄來的爆款文、剪映自動字幕。這些來源都會把「視頻、質量、屏幕」直接留在文案裡，台灣觀眾一看就出戲，品牌帳號還會被留言糾正。本工具內建 31 個常見大陸用語對照，一鍵換成台灣慣用說法：視頻→影片、質量→品質、立馬→立刻、鏈接→連結、軟件→軟體、屏幕→螢幕、信息→訊息、項目→專案、外賣→外送、盒飯→便當、充電寶→行動電源、U盤→隨身碟、雙肩包→後背包、衛衣→帽T、親們→各位、種草→被燒到、拔草→退坑、走心→用心、給力→罩、網紅→KOL。貼上文案，儀表板先顯示抓到幾處，再一鍵轉換。

guideZh.h: 廣告法規避雷：11 個高風險詞，一句話最高罰 500 萬
guideZh.p: 食品廣告依食品安全衛生管理法第 28 條：不實誇張處 4 萬–400 萬罰鍰，宣稱醫療效能處 60 萬–500 萬罰鍰；化粧品依化粧品衛生安全管理法不得宣稱醫療效能；「保證見效」類絕對化承諾涉及公平交易法第 21 條；「根治」類療效宣稱涉及醫療法第 84 條。本工具掃描 11 個常見高風險詞並自動換成合法說法：排毒→促進新陳代謝、瘦身→維持窈窕體態、減肥→輕盈順暢、燃脂→活力代謝、消炎→舒緩修護、抗敏→穩定敏弱膚況、生髮→強韌髮根、保證見效→眾多好評熱烈推薦、消除疲勞→精神旺盛、根治→全面溫和調理、美白淡斑→勻亮暗沉。團購文、直播腳本、KOL 合作 brief 都算廣告，一樣要掃。

guideZh.h: 發文前 30 秒檢查流程：貼上→看儀表板→一鍵轉換→人工再讀一次
guideZh.p: ①貼上文案（ChatGPT 草稿、小紅書抄來的、團購文都行）；②看上方兩格儀表板：大陸用語幾處、違規風險幾處；③按一鍵轉換，複製合規文案；④人工再讀一次：工具只掃文字不掃圖片，圖上文字、限動字幕要另外檢查；同音異義與語境要自己判斷（例如「質量」在物理文章裡是正確用法）；保健食品、醫美這類高風險產品，正式投放前建議再給法務或專業人士看一次。

faqZh.q: 支語轉換和簡轉繁有什麼不一樣？
faqZh.a: 簡轉繁只換字形——「視頻」轉完還是「視頻」，只是繁體字；支語轉換換的是用詞習慣，「視頻→影片、質量→品質、鏈接→連結」。而且本工具同時掃描廣告法規違規詞，簡轉繁工具不會做這件事。兩件事都要做：先簡轉繁，再做支語＋法規檢查。

faqZh.q: 工具轉完就保證不會被罰嗎？
faqZh.a: 不保證。本工具是發文前的第一道篩檢，掃描內建的 31 個常見大陸用語與 11 個高風險法規詞；法規認定看的是整段文案的整體脈絡與主管機關判斷，不是單一詞彙有沒有出現。保健食品、醫美、藥品相關文案，正式投放前建議再給法務或專業人士確認；文案最終責任在刊登者。

faqZh.q: 哪些文案最需要先掃一次？
faqZh.a: 食品與保健食品、化粧品與保養品、團購帶貨文、直播腳本、KOL 合作 brief——特別是寫了「效果承諾」的句子（瘦了、排毒、見效、根治）。另外，從 ChatGPT 或小紅書抄來的爆款文案最容易混進支語，貼到台灣帳號前先掃一次。

faqZh.q: 大陸用語一定要改嗎？有些詞台灣人也常用。
faqZh.a: 看場景。對台灣受眾的公開文案、品牌帳號建議改——被留言糾正一次，信任就扣一次分；私人聊天、引用原文、討論用語本身時不用改。工具的角色是幫你「看見」文案裡有哪些大陸用語與風險詞，改不改由你決定，不是一律封殺。

guideEn.h: Where mainland phrasing sneaks in: ChatGPT drafts, Xiaohongshu copy, auto subtitles
guideEn.p: Mainland terms in your copy usually aren't written on purpose — they leak in from three places: ChatGPT drafts (trained mostly on Simplified-Chinese corpora), viral Xiaohongshu posts, and auto-generated subtitles. All three leave 視頻, 質量, and 屏幕 sitting in your copy. Taiwanese readers notice instantly, and brand accounts get called out in the comments. This tool maps 31 common mainland terms to Taiwanese usage in one click: 視頻→影片 (video), 質量→品質 (quality), 立馬→立刻 (right away), 鏈接→連結 (link), 軟件→軟體 (software), 屏幕→螢幕 (screen), 信息→訊息 (message), 項目→專案 (project), 外賣→外送 (delivery), 盒飯→便當 (bento), 充電寶→行動電源 (power bank), U盤→隨身碟 (USB drive), 雙肩包→後背包 (backpack), 衛衣→帽T (hoodie), 親們→各位 (everyone), 種草→被燒到 (sold on it), 拔草→退坑 (un-sold), 走心→用心 (heartfelt), 給力→罩 (awesome), 網紅→KOL. Paste your copy, check the dashboard count, then convert.

guideEn.h: Ad-law minefield: 11 high-risk claims, fines up to NT$5 million
guideEn.p: Under Taiwan's Food Safety Act §28, misleading food ads draw NT$40,000–4,000,000 in fines, and ads claiming medical efficacy draw NT$600,000–5,000,000. Cosmetics may not claim medical efficacy under the Cosmetic Hygiene and Safety Act; absolute guarantees like 保證見效 implicate the Fair Trade Act §21; cure claims like 根治 implicate the Medical Care Act §84. The tool scans 11 common high-risk terms and swaps in compliant phrasing: 排毒→促進新陳代謝 (support metabolism), 瘦身→維持窈窕體態 (stay in shape), 減肥→輕盈順暢, 燃脂→活力代謝, 消炎→舒緩修護 (soothe and repair), 抗敏→穩定敏弱膚況, 生髮→強韌髮根 (stronger roots), 保證見效→眾多好評熱烈推薦 (widely praised), 消除疲勞→精神旺盛, 根治→全面溫和調理, 美白淡斑→勻亮暗沉 (brighten dullness). Group-buy copy, livestream scripts, and KOL briefs all count as advertising — scan them too.

guideEn.h: The 30-second pre-post check: paste, dashboard, convert, human re-read
guideEn.p: ① Paste your draft — a ChatGPT draft, borrowed Xiaohongshu copy, or group-buy post all work. ② Read the two dashboard tiles: how many mainland terms, how many legal risks. ③ Convert and copy the compliant version. ④ Re-read it once yourself: the tool scans text, not images, so check on-image text and Story subtitles separately; judge homonyms and context yourself (質量 is correct in a physics article); for high-risk categories like supplements or medical beauty, get a legal or professional review before paid placement.

faqEn.q: How is this different from Simplified-to-Traditional conversion?
faqEn.a: Simplified-to-Traditional only changes glyphs — 視頻 stays 視頻, just in Traditional characters. This tool changes word choice: 視頻→影片, 質量→品質, 鏈接→連結. It also scans for illegal ad claims, which converters never do. Do both: convert characters first, then run the phrasing and legal check.

faqEn.q: Does converted copy guarantee no fines?
faqEn.a: No. This is a first-pass screen over 31 mainland terms and 11 high-risk claim terms. Regulators judge the whole copy in context, not single words. For supplements, medical-beauty, or drug-adjacent copy, get legal or professional review before paid placement; the advertiser bears final responsibility.

faqEn.q: Which copy needs scanning most?
faqEn.a: Food and supplements, cosmetics and skincare, group-buy sales copy, livestream scripts, and KOL briefs — especially any sentence promising an outcome (slimmer, detox, guaranteed results, cure). Copy borrowed from ChatGPT or Xiaohongshu is the most likely to carry mainland phrasing; scan before posting to a Taiwan audience.

faqEn.q: Must every mainland term be changed? Some are common in Taiwan too.
faqEn.a: It depends on context. For public copy aimed at a Taiwan audience, change them — one callout in the comments costs trust. In private chat, quoted sources, or when discussing the terms themselves, leave them. The tool shows you what is in your copy; you decide what to change.

subtitle-tw.titleZh: 字幕台灣用語校正器｜剪映 SRT 簡體轉台灣繁體・時間碼不變｜字研所 TextLab
subtitle-tw.descriptionZh: 貼上剪映／CapCut 匯出的 SRT 字幕，簡體字轉台灣繁體、中國用語換台灣用法（視頻→影片、信息→資訊、網絡→網路），時間碼與序號原樣保留，可匯出 .srt 繼續剪輯。
subtitle-tw.titleEn: Subtitle Taiwanizer | SRT Simplified to Taiwan Traditional, Timecodes Intact | TextLab
subtitle-tw.descriptionEn: Paste SRT subtitles from CapCut: Simplified Chinese converts to Taiwan Traditional and mainland terms become Taiwanese usage, with timecodes untouched. Export as .srt.

guideZh.h: 剪映字幕為什麼是簡體＋中國用語
guideZh.p: 剪映／CapCut 的語音辨識預設輸出簡體中文，用詞也是中國用法：視頻、軟件、質量、信息、網絡。台灣觀眾對這些詞很敏感，留言常直接指出來。本工具處理兩層：先換詞組（視頻→影片、軟件→軟體、信息→資訊、網絡→網路、屏幕→螢幕、登錄→登入、默認→預設、點讚→按讚），再逐字轉換簡體字，詞典與字表都針對字幕語境校對過，歧義字（如「發、干、后、里」）用詞組規則處理，不會把「皇后」「占卜」「摩托車」改壞。

guideZh.h: SRT 時間碼不會被動到
guideZh.p: 工具逐行判讀 SRT 結構：含「-->」的時間碼行與純數字序號行直接原樣輸出，只有字幕文字行會被轉換。轉完顯示時間碼保留行數，可以對照原始檔檢查。匯出維持 .srt 格式與原始換行，丟回剪映、Premiere 或 YouTube 字幕上傳都能直接用。

guideZh.h: 純文字也能校正
guideZh.p: 輸入不含時間碼時，工具自動切為純文字模式：同樣做用語校正與簡轉繁，匯出為 .txt。適合先把口播稿、逐字稿校正完，再進剪輯軟體上字幕。

guideZh.h: 轉完請檢查這三類
guideZh.p: 第一，人名與專有名詞：一簡多繁採最常見對應，人名用字可能不同。第二，「質量」在物理語境（質量與能量）是台灣正確用法，科普類字幕請改回。第三，中國網路流行語（如「種草」）已對應台灣說法，但語氣是否符合你的頻道風格，還是要自己讀過一次。

faqZh.q: 轉換會不會改到 SRT 時間碼，害字幕對不上？
faqZh.a: 不會。時間碼行（含 --> 的行）與序號行逐行原樣保留，工具也以測試案例逐行驗證過。轉換結果會顯示保留的時間碼行數。

faqZh.q: 支援哪些字幕來源？
faqZh.a: 剪映、CapCut 匯出的 SRT 直接貼上或開檔都行；YouTube 下載的 SRT 也適用。純文字（口播稿、逐字稿）會自動以純文字模式處理，匯出 .txt。VTT 格式目前不在支援範圍。

faqZh.q: 簡體字都能轉對嗎？
faqZh.a: 內建字表收錄 480 多組常見簡繁對應，詞組詞典 100 多條。一簡多繁的字（如「发」可能是發或髮）用詞組規則先處理頭髮、理髮、髮型等常見組合，其餘採最常見對應。人名、專有名詞建議轉完再掃一次。

faqZh.q: 字幕內容會被上傳嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會。轉換全部在你的瀏覽器裡完成，字幕文字不離開你的裝置。

guideEn.h: Why CapCut subtitles come out in Simplified Chinese
guideEn.p: CapCut's speech recognition defaults to Simplified Chinese with mainland phrasing (視頻, 軟件, 信息, 網絡). This tool fixes both layers: phrase-level swaps to Taiwanese usage (視頻→影片, 信息→資訊, 網絡→網路, 登錄→登入, 默認→預設) and a character table of 480+ common Simplified-to-Traditional mappings tuned for subtitle text. Ambiguous characters are handled by phrase rules so words like 皇后 or 摩托車 are never corrupted.

guideEn.h: Timecodes are never touched
guideEn.p: The parser works line by line: lines containing '-->' and numeric index lines pass through byte-for-byte. Only subtitle text lines are converted. The result shows how many timecode lines were preserved, and the export keeps the original .srt structure for CapCut, Premiere or YouTube.

guideEn.h: Plain text mode
guideEn.p: If the input has no timecodes, the tool switches to plain-text mode automatically and exports .txt — handy for cleaning a script before it ever becomes subtitles.

faqEn.q: Will conversion break my SRT timing?
faqEn.a: No. Timecode lines and index lines are preserved verbatim, line by line, and the result reports how many timecode lines were kept.

faqEn.q: Which subtitle sources are supported?
faqEn.a: SRT files from CapCut/Jianying or YouTube work by paste or file open. Plain text is handled in text mode. VTT is not supported yet.

faqEn.q: Is my subtitle text uploaded anywhere?
faqEn.a: No. All conversion runs locally in your browser.

typeset.titleZh: 中文排版自動校正｜中英空格・半形標點轉全形・多餘空白清理｜字研所 TextLab
typeset.descriptionZh: 貼上文字，自動補上中文與英文、數字之間的空格，把中文語境的半形標點換成全形，清掉連續空白與多餘空行。程式碼、網址與英文句子受保護不誤改，並列出修正處數。
typeset.titleEn: Chinese Typesetting Fixer | CJK Spacing & Full-Width Punctuation | TextLab
typeset.descriptionEn: Paste Chinese text to add CJK–Latin spacing, convert half-width punctuation to full-width in Chinese context, and clean extra spaces and blank lines. Code, URLs and English sentences are protected.

guideZh.h: 中英之間為什麼要加空格
guideZh.p: 中文和英文字、數字直接黏在一起時，眼睛要在兩種字形系統之間硬切換，長段落讀起來明顯比較累。「使用Python寫程式」和「使用 Python 寫程式」的差別在短句不明顯，整篇報告、論文、部落格文章累積下來就是可讀性差距。這套規則源自 pangu（盤古）間距慣例，GitHub 上的 autocorrect 等開源工具也採同一套，本工具把它做成貼上就能用的網頁版，並逐處計數給你看。

guideZh.h: 半形標點在中文句子裡為什麼刺眼
guideZh.p: 中文句子裡混著 , . ? ! 這些半形標點，寬度只有全形的一半，視覺節奏會斷掉，交出去的報告、投稿、公文一看就知道沒整理。本工具只在前後文是中文時才轉換：句點前文是中文才換「。」，所以 3.14 的小數點、example.com 的網域、英文句子的句點都不會被動；冒號前文是數字（12:30）也保留。引號會配對換成「」，括號換成（）。

guideZh.h: 程式碼和網址怎麼保護
guideZh.p: 三種保護機制：反引號包住的行內程式碼整段跳過；縮排四格以上或 Tab 開頭的行視為程式碼行，不處理；``` 圍欄區塊整段保留。網址不需要保護也不會壞：網址內部的 . 與 : 前文都是英文字母，不符合轉換條件，中文側該補的空格與該轉的標點照常處理。

guideZh.h: 空白清理的範圍
guideZh.p: 連續兩個以上的半形空格收成一個，全形空格夾在中文之間直接移除、段落間三行以上的空行收成一行，行尾空白刪除，全形標點前後不留空格。英文單字之間的單一空格、數字小數點、程式碼縮排都不在清理範圍。

faqZh.q: 會不會把英文文章改壞？
faqZh.a: 不會。所有規則都要求前後文出現中文才觸發：純英文段落貼進來，輸出會和原文相同，修正處數為 0。測試案例包含完整英文句子、小數 3.14、網址與時間 12:30，都驗證不誤改。

faqZh.q: 「第3名」會被加空格變成「第 3 名」嗎？
faqZh.a: 會，這是 pangu 規則的標準行為（中文與數字之間一律加空格）。若你的文體不接受這種寫法，建議校正後全文搜尋「第 」再自行決定保留與否。

faqZh.q: 程式碼貼進去會被改掉嗎？
faqZh.a: 用反引號包住的行內程式碼、縮排四格以上的程式碼行、``` 圍欄區塊都會被跳過。沒有縮排又沒有反引號的程式碼片段，裡面的逗號若前後有中文仍可能被轉換，貼之前請先包好。

faqZh.q: 文字會被上傳嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會。校正全部在你的瀏覽器裡用固定規則完成，沒有 AI、沒有伺服器處理。

guideEn.h: Why spacing between Chinese and Latin text matters
guideEn.p: Chinese characters glued directly to Latin words or digits force the reader's eyes to switch scripts mid-line. The pangu spacing convention — a space between CJK and Latin/digits — is what open-source tools like autocorrect implement; this tool brings it to a paste-and-fix web page and counts every change it makes.

guideEn.h: Punctuation conversion is context-gated
guideEn.p: Half-width , . ? ! convert to full-width only when surrounded by Chinese context. A period becomes 。 only after Chinese text, so decimals (3.14), domains (example.com) and English sentences are never touched; a colon after digits (12:30) stays as-is. Quotes are paired into 「」 and parentheses into （）.

guideEn.h: Code and URL protection
guideEn.p: Inline code in backticks, lines indented 4+ spaces, and ``` fenced blocks are skipped entirely. URLs need no protection: their dots and colons follow Latin letters, which never trigger conversion.

faqEn.q: Will it damage English text?
faqEn.a: No. Every rule requires Chinese context to trigger. Pure English input comes out identical with zero fixes.

faqEn.q: Is my text uploaded?
faqEn.a: No. All rules run locally in your browser — no AI, no server.

transcript.titleZh: 逐字稿清理器｜去贅詞・自動分段・補標點（規則式）｜字研所 TextLab
transcript.descriptionZh: 貼上語音轉文字的逐字稿，規則式移除嗯、呃、就是說、停頓的那個與重複語氣詞，長句補逗號、自動分段、段末補句號。有語意的詞保留不動，介面明載規則式清理的限制。
transcript.titleEn: Transcript Cleaner | Remove Fillers, Split Paragraphs, Add Punctuation | TextLab
transcript.descriptionEn: Paste a speech-to-text transcript to remove fillers, add commas to long clauses, split paragraphs and complete sentence endings — rule-based, with its limits stated upfront.

guideZh.h: 逐字稿為什麼不能直接用
guideZh.p: Whisper、剪映、手機語音輸入產出的逐字稿有三個共同問題：贅詞（嗯、那個、就是說）密度高、標點常常缺失或亂給、整段不分段黏成一坨。這種稿子直接拿去當會議紀錄、訪談整理或影片文案，讀的人要在腦中自己斷句，編輯要先花半小時清稿。本工具處理的就是這三件事，而且只做這三件：清贅詞、補基本標點、切段落，不改寫、不摘要、不動你的原意。

guideZh.h: 贅詞怎麼判定：只清標點旁邊的
guideZh.p: 「那個」是最容易誤殺的詞：「那個報告我看過了」的那個是指示詞，刪掉句子就壞了；「嗯，那個，我想說」的那個是停頓填充，刪掉完全不影響。本工具的判定規則是位置：只有出現在句首、逗號前後的那個（後面緊跟逗號）才清除，那個＋名詞一律保留。嗯和呃同理，只清獨立出現在標點旁邊的；「他嗯了一聲」的嗯有語意，保留。「我就是說你錯了」的就是說有主詞結構，保留；標點相鄰的「，就是說，」才清。

guideZh.h: 分段與補標點的規則
guideZh.p: 段末沒有結束標點就補句號；超過 30 字的子句若完全沒有逗號，會在第一個轉折詞（但是、所以、然後、因為等）前面補一個逗號，一個子句最多補一處，避免把句子切碎。分段以句子為單位累積，段落超過約 150 字、或新句子以轉折詞開頭且前段已超過 60 字，就另起一段。你原本用空行分好的段落會被保留，不會被合併。

guideZh.h: 規則式的限制（先講清楚）
guideZh.p: 這套清理沒有 AI、不理解語意，所以：同音字錯誤（在、再不分）修不了；該斷句沒斷、斷錯位置的情況一定存在；專有名詞、人名、數字的對錯它無法判斷。它的定位是把一份原始稿從「不能看」清到「可以開始校對」，省下的是機械清理的時間。訪談紀錄、會議決議、要投稿或公開的文字，清完之後請務必人工通讀一次。

faqZh.q: 會不會把有意義的句子刪掉？
faqZh.a: 規則採保守設計：所有刪除都要求贅詞出現在標點相鄰位置且後接逗號或標點。實測案例包括「那個報告我看過了」（保留）、「他嗯了一聲就走了」（保留）、「對對對，就是這樣」（只收斂重複的對）。清理結果會列出每種贅詞刪了幾處，你可以對照原文檢查。

faqZh.q: 跟丟給 AI 整理有什麼不同？
faqZh.a: AI 整理會改寫句子、可能增刪內容，長稿還要分段貼；本工具只做規則能確定的事：刪明確贅詞、補標點、分段，原句一字不改、全文一次處理。需要改寫潤稿的場合用 AI，需要忠實原稿的第一輪清理用這個。

faqZh.q: 英文逐字稿可以用嗎？
faqZh.a: 不建議。贅詞、分段與補標點規則都是針對中文設計的，英文稿只會被切段與補句號，效果有限。

faqZh.q: 文字會被上傳嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會。清理全部在你的瀏覽器裡用固定規則完成，沒有伺服器處理。

guideEn.h: Why raw transcripts are unusable
guideEn.p: Speech-to-text output has three recurring problems: dense fillers, missing or random punctuation, and no paragraph breaks. This tool handles exactly those three — removes fillers, adds basic punctuation, splits paragraphs — without rewriting or summarizing your words.

guideEn.h: Fillers are judged by position
guideEn.p: The Chinese filler 那個 is also a demonstrative (that report), so deletion requires it to sit next to punctuation followed by a comma — the stalling kind. 那個 + noun is always kept; 嗯 inside a meaningful phrase is kept; only standalone fillers by punctuation are removed.

guideEn.h: Stated limits
guideEn.p: Rule-based means no semantics: homophone errors stay, some breaks will be wrong, names and numbers can't be verified. It takes a raw transcript from unreadable to proofread-able — important documents still need a human pass.

faqEn.q: Can it delete meaningful sentences?
faqEn.a: The rules are conservative: deletion only triggers for fillers adjacent to punctuation. The result lists exactly how many of each filler were removed so you can audit against the original.

faqEn.q: Is my text uploaded?
faqEn.a: No. Everything runs locally in your browser with fixed rules.

dedup.titleZh: 刪除重複行｜文字去重工具：一鍵刪重複行、保留首次順序｜字研所 TextLab
dedup.descriptionZh: 貼上清單或文本，一鍵刪除重複行：保留首次出現順序，可選忽略大小寫、去除每行前後空白，並顯示刪了幾行。文字去重全程在瀏覽器完成，免費免登入。
dedup.titleEn: Remove Duplicate Lines | Deduplicate Text, Keep First Occurrence | TextLab
dedup.descriptionEn: Paste a list or text to remove duplicate lines in one click: first-occurrence order is kept, with optional ignore-case and trim-whitespace, and a count of removed lines. Runs entirely in your browser. Free, no sign-up.

guideZh.h: 什麼時候需要刪除重複行
guideZh.p: 整理名單（通訊錄、客戶名單、標籤清單）、問卷回覆、程式 log、書單時，貼上就有一堆重複，人工逐行比對眼睛會花。本工具只做一件事：以整行為單位比對，刪掉後面重複出現的行，保留第一次出現的順序，不排序、不改字。

guideZh.h: 兩個選項怎麼用
guideZh.p: 忽略大小寫：Apple 和 apple 視為同一行，輸出保留第一次出現的寫法。去除每行前後空白：比對前先去頭尾空白，輸出也是去空白後的行。兩個開關預設都是關，純去重不動原文最保險；貼來的清單常帶空白時再打開去空白。

guideZh.h: 空白行與換行的處理
guideZh.p: 空白行視為一般行：連續多個空白行只留一個，單一空白行保留，不會整段清掉。換行輸出統一為換行字元；輸入結尾有沒有換行，輸出會如實保留。

guideZh.h: 誠實限制
guideZh.p: 只比對整行文字，不理解語意：全形Ａ與半形 A、簡體與繁體視為不同行；忽略大小寫只處理英文字母。處理全在本機瀏覽器完成，文字不上傳。

faqZh.q: 會不會改變原本的順序？
faqZh.a: 不會。只刪除後面重複出現的行，第一次出現的位置與順序完全保留，不排序。

faqZh.q: 空白行會被清掉嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會全部清掉。空白行視為一般行：連續多個空白行只留一個，單一空白行保留；想整段清掉空白行請先用其他方式處理。

faqZh.q: 大小寫不同算重複嗎？
faqZh.a: 預設不算，Apple 和 apple 是兩行；打開「忽略大小寫」才視為同一行，輸出保留第一次出現的寫法。

faqZh.q: 文字會被上傳嗎？
faqZh.a: 不會。去重全部在你的瀏覽器裡用固定規則完成，沒有伺服器處理。

guideEn.h: When you need it
guideEn.p: Cleaning contact lists, survey responses, logs or reading lists often leaves duplicates that are painful to compare by eye. This tool does one job: compare whole lines, drop later duplicates, keep first-occurrence order — no sorting, no rewriting.

guideEn.h: Options
guideEn.p: Ignore case treats Apple and apple as the same line, keeping the first spelling. Trim removes leading and trailing whitespace before comparing, and the output is trimmed too. Both default to off, so plain dedup never touches your original text.

guideEn.h: Stated limits
guideEn.p: Whole-line comparison only, no semantics: fullwidth and halfwidth forms, or simplified and traditional variants, count as different lines. Everything runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

faqEn.q: Does it change the order?
faqEn.a: No. Only later duplicates are removed; first-occurrence positions and order are fully preserved, never sorted.

faqEn.q: Is my text uploaded?
faqEn.a: No. Everything runs locally in your browser with fixed rules.

blank-id.titleZh: 空白ID產生器｜遊戲隱形名字・空白暱稱一鍵複製（傳說對決、Free Fire）｜字研所 TextLab
blank-id.descriptionZh: 免費空白ID產生器：一鍵產生遊戲隱形名字與空白暱稱，適用傳說對決、Free Fire、王者榮耀等手遊。選長度、挑配方、直接複製貼上，免安裝免註冊。
blank-id.titleEn: Invisible Game Name Generator | Blank ID Maker for Mobile Games | TextLab
blank-id.descriptionEn: Free invisible name generator for games: create blank IDs and invisible nicknames for mobile games like Arena of Valor and Free Fire. Pick a length, choose a recipe, copy and paste. No signup needed.

guideZh.h: 什麼是空白 ID？
guideZh.p: 空白 ID 就是用「看不見的 Unicode 字元」組成的遊戲暱稱，在遊戲裡看起來像是沒有名字或只有空白。常用字元有諺文填充字元（U+3164）、點字空格（U+2800）、零寬空格（U+200B）等——它們都是真正的字元，所以能通過暱稱「不能為空」的檢查，眼睛卻看不到。

guideZh.h: 三步驟做出隱形名字
guideZh.p: 1. 選擇想要的長度（1–12 個字元，建議 4–8 個）；2. 挑一種配方——「通用配方」相容性最廣，「混合配方」把多種空白字元交錯組合，被平台擋下時換配方再試；3. 按「產生隱形名字」→ 複製 → 貼到遊戲暱稱欄位。如果遊戲提示名稱不合法，換另一個配方或縮短長度再試一次。

guideZh.h: 各遊戲的暱稱規則差很大
guideZh.p: 傳說對決、Free Fire、王者榮耀等手遊對特殊字元的過濾規則都不同，而且官方可能隨時更新。有的遊戲接受諺文字元但擋零寬字元，有的反過來。建議一次產生多個版本，用不同配方輪流測試，把能成功改名的那個留下來。

guideZh.h: 四種配方怎麼選：通用、段落、零寬、混合
guideZh.p: 產生器提供四種配方，選錯配方是被擋下最常見的原因。通用配方（U+3164 諺文填充字元）相容性最廣，先從它開始，適合傳說對決、Free Fire 與 IG 暱稱；段落配方（U+2800 點字空格）佔位較寬，適合想要長一點留白或貼到聊天室；零寬配方（U+200B 零寬空格）完全不佔寬度，適合過濾嚴格的平台；四種都試過仍被擋，就換混合配方——它把 U+3164、U+2800、U+200B、U+2060 交錯組合，單一字元規則擋不下來。

guideZh.h: 長度怎麼選：2、4、8、12 個字元的差別
guideZh.p: 長度預設是 4 個字元，也可以按 2、4、8、12 快速切換，或用加減號在 1 到 12 之間微調。字元太少時，有些平台會把名字判定為「空白」而退件；字元太多則可能吃掉暱稱的字數上限，或在某些遊戲裡顯示異常。建議先用預設 4 個試，被擋下再往 8 或 12 調，或改換混合配方；每次產生後，下方的碼點預覽會列出每個字元的編號，確認無誤再複製。

guideZh.h: 改名可能要花錢：先免費試好再確認
guideZh.p: 很多遊戲的改名不是免費的，常常要花改名卡或遊戲內貨幣，改下去就不能反悔。正確流程是：先在產生器的貼上測試區貼一次，看到字元數正確顯示，再到遊戲的改名欄位貼上、看預覽——預覽看起來是空白才按確認。如果預覽就顯示方框或被退件，退回來換配方重試，不要先花掉改名卡。改名前也先想好一個正常備用名字，萬一平台日後清掉隱形字元，還能立刻換回來。

faqZh.q: 空白ID產生器是免費的嗎？需要註冊嗎？
faqZh.a: 完全免費、不需註冊。所有產生與複製都在你的瀏覽器內完成，輸入與產生的名字不會上傳到任何伺服器。

faqZh.q: 為什麼貼到遊戲裡名字還是顯示不出來或被擋下？
faqZh.a: 每款遊戲對空白字元的過濾規則不同，有些字元在 A 遊戲能用、在 B 遊戲會被判定為非法名稱。換一個配方（通用／段落／混合）或縮短長度再試，通常就能找到該遊戲接受的組合。

faqZh.q: 隱形名字會不會被官方封號？
faqZh.a: 空白字元本身只是 Unicode 符號，不屬於外掛或修改程式，多數遊戲把它視為普通暱稱。但部分遊戲的賽事規章可能要求暱稱「可辨識」，參賽或開實況前建議先換回普通名字。

faqZh.q: 手機和電腦都能用嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以。這個工具是網頁版，手機、平板、電腦的瀏覽器都能開；產生後長按（或右鍵）複製，貼到遊戲的暱稱輸入框即可。

faqZh.q: 複製後看起來是空的，怎麼確認真的有複製到？
faqZh.a: 把複製的內容貼到產生器下方的貼上測試區：如果字元數顯示大於 0、貼上時游標有往右移動，就代表字元確實存在，只是眼睛看不見。產生畫面下方的碼點預覽（例如 U+3164）也會列出每個字元的編號，可以逐一核對。

faqZh.q: 為什麼朋友看我的名字是空白，我自己看卻有方框？
faqZh.a: 方框是裝置字體缺字元時的替代顯示，代表你的裝置沒有這個隱形字元的字型，不代表名字壞了。換成相容性最廣的通用配方（U+3164）通常就能解決；也可以先貼到另一台手機或電腦確認，別人的裝置顯示正常就沒問題。

faqZh.q: 空白名字可以跟正常文字混搭嗎？
faqZh.a: 可以，但要分兩步做：產生器只產出純空白字元，先複製貼到遊戲欄位，再接著輸入你想顯示的文字，就能做出「前面空白、後面有字」的效果。不過有些遊戲會自動把開頭的空白截掉，貼好後務必看預覽確認，截掉了就改放文字後面或只用純空白名字。

guideEn.h: What is a blank ID?
guideEn.p: A blank ID is a game nickname made of invisible Unicode characters (like U+3164 Hangul filler, U+2800 braille space, U+200B zero-width space). They are real characters, so they pass the "name cannot be empty" check while looking completely empty in-game.

guideEn.h: Make an invisible name in 3 steps
guideEn.p: 1. Choose a length (1–12 characters, 4–8 works well). 2. Pick a recipe — the Universal recipe has the widest compatibility, the Mixed recipe interleaves several blank characters to beat platform filters. 3. Hit generate, copy, and paste into your game's nickname field. If the game rejects it, switch recipes or shorten the length and try again.

guideEn.h: Why your blank name gets rejected — and how to fix it
guideEn.p: Games update their name filters all the time, so a recipe that works today can fail after the next update. When a name is rejected: (1) switch recipes — try Universal (U+3164), then Paragraph (U+2800), then Zero-width (U+200B), and finally Mixed, which interleaves four blank characters and is the best fallback when single characters get blocked; (2) change the length — this tool generates 1–12 characters, and some games require a 2–3 character minimum; (3) verify first with the paste-test box and the code-point preview, so you know the characters really copied before you spend a rename card or in-game diamonds on the change.

guideEn.h: Which games accept invisible names? What players report
guideEn.p: Player communities report that Hangul Filler (U+3164) is the most widely accepted invisible character — used for blank names in Free Fire, PUBG Mobile, Roblox, Fortnite and Discord — while Braille Blank (U+2800) is reported as reliable in PUBG/BGMI, and Zero-width space (U+200B) works on Discord but is rejected by several games. Filters change with every update, so no single character works forever: generate with a different recipe in this tool and test until one passes.

guideEn.h: Which recipe should you pick? Universal, Paragraph, Zero-width, Mixed
guideEn.p: Picking the wrong recipe is the most common reason a blank name gets rejected. Start with the Universal recipe (U+3164 Hangul filler) — it has the widest compatibility and fits Arena of Valor, Free Fire and Instagram names. The Paragraph recipe (U+2800 Braille blank) takes up more width, good for a longer blank or chat messages. The Zero-width recipe (U+200B) takes no width at all, for platforms with strict filters. If all three fail, switch to Mixed: it interleaves U+3164, U+2800, U+200B and U+2060, so a rule blocking a single character cannot catch it.

guideEn.h: What length should you choose? 2, 4, 8 or 12 characters
guideEn.p: The default length is 4 characters, with quick presets of 2, 4, 8 and 12, or a stepper to fine-tune anywhere from 1 to 12. Too few characters and some platforms treat the name as empty and reject it; too many and you may eat into the nickname character limit or see odd rendering in some games. Start with the default 4, and if it gets rejected, try 8 or 12, or switch to the Mixed recipe. The codepoint preview below the generated name lists every character so you can verify before copying.

guideEn.h: Renames can cost money: test free before you confirm
guideEn.p: Many games charge a rename card or in-game currency for a name change, and there is no undo. The safe flow is: paste into the generator's paste-test box first and check the character count, then paste into the game's rename field and look at the preview — only confirm when the preview looks blank. If the preview shows boxes or gets rejected, go back and try another recipe instead of spending the rename card. Also prepare a normal backup name first, so you can switch back quickly if the platform ever cleans up invisible characters.

faqEn.q: Is the invisible name generator free? Do I need an account?
faqEn.a: Yes, completely free and no account needed. Everything runs in your browser; nothing you generate is uploaded anywhere.

faqEn.q: Why does my game reject the generated name?
faqEn.a: Every game filters blank characters differently — a character accepted in one game may be rejected in another. Switch to another recipe or try a shorter length until the game accepts it.

faqEn.q: Can using an invisible name get me banned?
faqEn.a: Blank characters are plain Unicode symbols, not hacks or mods, and most games treat them as normal nicknames. Some tournaments require readable names, so switch back to a normal name before competitive events.

faqEn.q: Why does my invisible name show as a box (□) on some devices?
faqEn.a: That box means the device's font has no glyph for the character — it is a font fallback, not a broken name. Switch to a recipe with wider font support: Hangul Filler (U+3164, the Universal recipe) renders correctly on the widest range of phones.

faqEn.q: I copied it but it looks empty — how do I know it actually copied?
faqEn.a: Paste it into the paste-test box below the generator: if the character count shows more than 0 and the cursor moves right when you paste, the characters are really there — they are just invisible. The codepoint preview under the generated name (for example U+3164) also lists every character so you can check them one by one.

faqEn.q: Why do my friends see a blank name but I see a box?
faqEn.a: The box is a font fallback: your device lacks a glyph for that invisible character, which does not mean the name is broken. Switching to the most compatible Universal recipe (U+3164) usually fixes it. You can also paste it on another phone or computer to confirm — if it looks blank there, you are fine.

faqEn.q: Can I mix a blank name with visible text?
faqEn.a: Yes, in two steps: the generator only outputs pure blank characters, so paste those into the game field first, then type the text you want to show after them for a blank-then-text effect. Note that some games trim leading blanks automatically, so always check the preview after pasting — if the blank got trimmed, put it after the text or use a pure blank name instead.

counter.titleZh: 字數計數器｜IG 貼文 2200 字、自介 150 字、Hashtag 上限即時檢查｜字研所 TextLab
counter.descriptionZh: 免費即時計算字數，一次對照 IG 貼文 2200 字、IG 自介 150 字、Hashtag 30 個上限，超標自動紅色警示。
counter.titleEn: Character Counter | IG Post & Bio Limits Live Check | TextLab
counter.descriptionEn: Free live character counter: check IG post (2200), IG bio (150) and hashtag (30) limits at once with over-limit alerts.

guideZh.h: 字數計數器怎麼用？
guideZh.p: 把文字貼進輸入框，總字數、IG 貼文、IG 自介、Hashtag 四個數字即時更新。超過上限的那一列會變紅色，一眼就知道哪裡要刪。

guideZh.h: IG 各種字數上限是多少？
guideZh.p: IG 貼文上限 2200 字（但超過 125 字會在動態被摺疊）、IG 個人簡介上限 150 字、單篇貼文 Hashtag 上限 30 個。Threads 貼文上限是 500 字。

guideZh.h: Hashtag 怎麼算？
guideZh.p: 只計算 # 開頭的詞，例如「#美食」算一個，單獨一個 # 不算。建議 Hashtag 放在留言或文末，不要塞在內文影響閱讀。

guideZh.h: 超過 125 字會被摺疊：第一行決定生死
guideZh.p: IG 貼文上限 2200 字，但動態牆只顯示前約 125 字，後面全被「…更多」藏起來。所以最重要的鉤子、關鍵數字、行動呼籲都要擠進前兩行：把「限時 3 天」「最後 10 名」放開頭，不要放結尾。寫完用計數器數到 125，確認「更多」之前出現的是不是你最想讓路人看到的話。想系統性練開頭，可以參考爆款 Hook 產生器的開頭公式。

guideZh.h: Threads 500 字陷阱：Emoji 和中文會吃掉你的額度
guideZh.p: Threads 官方 API 文件是按 UTF-8 位元組計算字數（一個 Emoji 佔 4 個位元組），不是照你眼睛看到的「幾個字」算；App 端實際怎麼算還可能跟 API 不一樣。實務原則：文中 Emoji 多、或字數接近 500 時，至少留一成緩衝（450 字左右就當上限），否則發出去被退件最麻煩。貼文前先把全文貼進計數器看總字數，超過 450 就先刪。

guideZh.h: 一稿三發：Threads 500／IG 2200／X 280 的裁剪流程
guideZh.p: 同一個消息要發三個平台時，先寫完整版（IG 的 2200 字夠你講故事），再往下裁：Threads 版砍到 450 字內，長列表改成「詳細放留言」；X 版壓到 280 字內，只留一句話加連結。刪的順序是：例子先刪、形容詞次之，核心訊息和連結最後才動。每一版裁完都用計數器驗一次，不要憑感覺。

faqZh.q: 中文字跟英文字都算一個字嗎？
faqZh.a: 這裡一個字就是一個字元，中英、標點、空格都各算一字。Emoji 依字元計算，IG 實際計算方式可能略有差異，接近上限時建議留一點緩衝。

faqZh.q: 超過 IG 上限會怎樣？
faqZh.a: IG 貼文超過 2200 字會無法發布；自介超過 150 字會被截掉。發文前先用計數器檢查，比被退件重打更省時間。

faqZh.q: 為什麼字數明明沒超，貼到 IG 卻發不出去？
faqZh.a: 最常見的兇手是看不見的字元：從網頁複製來的零寬空格（U+200B）、不斷行空格會被平台計入字數，但肉眼看不到。另一個可能是全形符號被當成多個字元計算。解法：把文字貼進計數器，逐段刪除測試是哪一段出問題；或先用空白文字工具把可疑字元清掉再重貼。

faqZh.q: Emoji 到底算幾個字？
faqZh.a: 在這個計數器裡，一個 Emoji 算一個字元；但各平台算法不同：Threads 官方文件以位元組計算，一個 Emoji 佔 4 個位元組，實際吃掉的額度比看起來多。IG 自介只有 150 字，放兩三個 Emoji 就少掉好幾個字的位置，排版時把 Emoji 當成「佔位大戶」來規劃。

faqZh.q: Hashtag 放內文跟放留言，效果一樣嗎？
faqZh.a: 字數計算上：30 個上限是以「單篇貼文」為單位，內文加留言合併計算，放哪裡都佔額度。閱讀體驗上：塞在內文會打斷句子，放在文末或第一則留言比較乾淨。計數器只算你貼進來的文字，記得把留言那一則也一起算進去。

faqZh.q: IG 自介 150 字不夠寫怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: 自介 150 字是硬上限，寫不下就用四行公式：第一行你是誰、第二行你提供什麼、第三行證明（數字或經歷）、第四行動呼籲。連結放在專屬的連結欄位，不佔自介字數，不要把網址塞進文字裡。更完整的排版心法可以看 Bio 排版工具的指南。

guideEn.h: How does the counter work?
guideEn.p: Paste your text and watch four numbers update live: total characters, IG post, IG bio and hashtag counts. Over-limit rows turn red.

guideEn.h: What are Instagram's limits?
guideEn.p: IG posts: 2200 chars (folds after 125 in feed), IG bio: 150 chars, hashtags: 30 per post. Threads posts: 500 chars.

guideEn.h: The 125-character fold: your first line decides everything
guideEn.p: IG captions allow 2200 characters, but the feed shows only about the first 125 before "…more" hides the rest. Front-load your hook, key numbers and call-to-action into the first two lines — put "3 days only" or "last 10 spots" up top, not at the end. Paste into the counter, count to 125, and check what a scroller actually sees.

guideEn.h: Threads' 500-character trap: emoji and CJK eat your budget
guideEn.p: Threads' official API docs count post length in UTF-8 bytes — one emoji costs 4 bytes — not in the characters you see; the app itself may count differently again. Rule of thumb: if your post is emoji-heavy or near the limit, treat ~450 as the real ceiling and keep a 10–15% buffer, or it gets rejected at publish time. Check the total in the counter before posting.

faqEn.q: How are hashtags counted?
faqEn.a: Only words starting with # count, e.g. #food counts as one. A lone # does not count.

faqEn.q: Why does my caption fail even though I'm under the limit?
faqEn.a: The usual culprit is invisible characters: zero-width spaces (U+200B) or non-breaking spaces copied from web pages count toward the limit but can't be seen. Fix: paste your text into the counter and delete section by section to find the offender, or strip suspicious characters with the blank-text cleaner on the blank page.

faqEn.q: How many characters is one emoji?
faqEn.a: In this counter, one emoji is one character — but platforms disagree. Threads' official docs count in bytes, where one emoji costs 4 bytes, so emoji-heavy posts burn through the 500 budget faster than they look. Treat emoji as space-hungry when laying out a tight bio.

faqEn.q: Do hashtags in comments count toward the 30-hashtag limit?
faqEn.a: The 30-hashtag cap applies per post, combining caption and comments — wherever you put them, they eat the quota. Hashtags stuffed mid-caption also break up your sentences, so put them at the end or in the first comment for cleaner reading. The counter only counts what you paste, so include the comment text too.

horror.titleZh: 恐怖文字產生器｜Zalgo 故障風格文字一鍵生成｜字研所 TextLab
horror.descriptionZh: 免費把一般文字變成 Zalgo 恐怖故障風，三種強度可選，萬聖節、迷因、遊戲暱稱嚇人專用，一鍵複製。
horror.titleEn: Glitch Text Generator | Zalgo Horror Text | TextLab
horror.descriptionEn: Turn plain text into Zalgo glitch horror text with three intensity levels. Free, one-click copy for Halloween and memes.

guideZh.h: 恐怖文字是怎麼運作的？
guideZh.p: 在每個字的上下疊加 Unicode 組合符號（U+0300–U+036F），讓文字看起來像被干擾、腐蝕一樣。因為是純文字，貼到 IG、Discord、遊戲暱稱都能顯示。

guideZh.h: 三種強度差在哪？
guideZh.p: 輕微只加少量干擾還看得出原字；中度詭異感十足；重度幾乎看不出原字，適合純嚇人。不滿意可以按「換一種」重新隨機組合。

guideZh.h: 適合用在哪？
guideZh.p: 萬聖節貼文、迷因圖配文、恐怖遊戲暱稱、Discord 群組嚇朋友。不建議用在正式文件，對方可能看不懂。

guideZh.h: 強度選用心法：想貼得出去，先從「輕微」開始
guideZh.p: 三個強度（輕微／中度／重度）差的不只是嚇人程度，還有「貼得出去」的成功率。X（Twitter）等平台會過濾疊太多組合符號的文字，強度開太高可能整段被擋或被還原成普通字。實戰心法：IG 自介、Threads 貼文、遊戲暱稱一律先用「輕微」或「中度」測試，貼得出去再調高；「重度」留給萬聖節海報、迷因圖這種一次性的嚇人場合。不滿意可以按「換一種」重新隨機組合。

guideZh.h: 貼上後被裁掉或變方框？先貼到目標 App 預覽
guideZh.p: 同一段恐怖文字，在你的手機和朋友的手機上可能長得不一樣：Android、iOS、Windows 各自的文字渲染引擎處理疊加符號的方式不同，溢出上下行的量也不同。貼到 IG 自介或限動時，超出格子的部分會被直接裁掉——解決方法永遠是「降強度重貼」，不要反向加碼。如果看到方框 □，代表那支手機的字型缺了某些組合符號，通常是舊裝置，換輕微強度或換台新手機看就正常了。

guideZh.h: 搜尋冷知識：恐怖文字會被當成亂碼
guideZh.p: 把恐怖文字貼到 LINE 群組或記事本之後，用普通關鍵字搜尋是找不到它的——搜尋引擎和 App 內搜尋認不出組合符號底下的原字，會把它當成亂碼處理。所以：重要資訊（地址、價格、聯絡方式、約定時間）永遠用普通字寫，恐怖文字只負責嚇人；檔案名也不要用恐怖文字，某些系統會拒絕儲存。想把被「詛咒」的文字還原？做一次 Unicode 正規化、去掉組合符號區段的字元，原字就會回來。

faqZh.q: 恐怖文字在手機上看得到嗎？
faqZh.a: 大部分新手機都支援組合符號顯示。強度開到重度時，極少數舊手機可能顯示不全，正式使用前先貼到目標 App 看一眼。

faqZh.q: 會影響無障礙閱讀嗎？
faqZh.a: 會。螢幕報讀軟體會把每個組合符號都念出來，視障朋友會聽到一堆雜音，所以只適合裝飾娛樂用途。

faqZh.q: 貼到 IG、Threads、X 會不會被擋掉？
faqZh.a: 大部分情況貼得上去。X（Twitter）對組合符號數量最敏感，強度開太高可能被過濾或還原；IG、Threads 通常能貼，但重度強度超出自介格子時會被裁掉。建議一律先用「輕微」或「中度」在目標 App 預覽，確認顯示正常再用。重要資訊不要只用恐怖文字寫。

faqZh.q: 為什麼同一段文字在我的手機和朋友手機上看起來不一樣？
faqZh.a: 這是正常的。Android、iOS、Windows 的文字渲染引擎疊加組合符號的方式各不相同，同樣的文字在不同裝置上溢出的高度、裁掉的位置都會有差異。想讓所有人看到差不多的樣子，就用「輕微」或「中度」，重度強度的差異會被放大。

faqZh.q: 恐怖文字可以用搜尋找到嗎？
faqZh.a: 不行。用普通關鍵字搜尋時，搜尋引擎和 App 內搜尋都認不出組合符號底下的原字，會把它當亂碼。所以貼在群組裡的恐怖文字，別人用搜尋是找不到的；寫在貼文裡也不會被當成關鍵字收錄。只拿它做裝飾，別指望它被搜到。

guideEn.h: How does glitch text work?
guideEn.p: It stacks Unicode combining marks (U+0300–U+036F) above and below each character for a corrupted, haunted look. Pure text — pastes anywhere.

guideEn.h: What are the intensity levels?
guideEn.p: Light adds subtle corruption, Medium looks properly eerie, Heavy is barely readable. Hit shuffle to re-roll the combination.

guideEn.h: Platform playbook: start at Light if you need it to post
guideEn.p: The three intensity levels aren't just about scariness — they decide whether your text survives. X (Twitter) is famous for filtering text with too many combining marks, and heavy glitch may get stripped or flattened back to plain text. Play it safe: bios, Threads posts and game names should start at Light or Medium, preview them in the target app, and only then dial up. Save Heavy for one-off scares like Halloween posters and memes. Hit shuffle to re-roll the combination if you don't like the look.

guideEn.h: Clipped or boxed? Troubleshoot before you panic
guideEn.p: The same glitch string can look different on your phone and your friend's: Android, iOS and Windows each render stacked marks their own way, and the amount of overflow differs. If Instagram crops the top or bottom of your bio, the fix is always to lower the intensity and repost — never raise it. Seeing boxes □ means the device's fonts are missing some combining marks (usually an old phone); switch to Light or view it on a newer device.

faqEn.q: Will it display on phones?
faqEn.a: Most modern phones render combining marks fine. On very old devices heavy glitch may break — preview in your target app first.

faqEn.q: Can people search for glitch text?
faqEn.a: No. Search engines and in-app search can't match the base words under the combining marks, so a zalgo string reads as gibberish to them. Glitch text pasted in a chat can't be found with a normal keyword search, and it won't be indexed as keywords in posts. Use it for decoration only.

faqEn.q: Can screen readers read glitch text?
faqEn.a: No. Screen readers announce every combining mark one by one, so visually impaired readers hear a wall of noise instead of your message. Keep addresses, prices, contact details and anything important in plain text — glitch text is decoration, not communication.

limbs.titleZh: 手腳文字產生器｜給每個字加上舉手小手 ୧୨｜字研所 TextLab
limbs.descriptionZh: 免費把文字變成手腳文字，用 ୧ ୨ 幫每個字加上舉起的小手，遊戲暱稱、IG 簡介裝可愛專用，一鍵複製。
limbs.titleEn: Limb Text Generator | Cute Dancing Text ୧୨ | TextLab
limbs.descriptionEn: Add little raised arms ୧୨ to every character. Free cute dancing text for game names and bios, one-click copy.

guideZh.h: 手腳文字是什麼？
guideZh.p: 概念來自韓國 SNS 的 팔다리 글씨（原版是韓文子音替換，只支援韓文）。中文版用看起來像舉起小手的符號 ୧ ୨，把每個字框起來，整句話像在跳舞一樣。

guideZh.h: 兩種模式差在哪？
guideZh.p: 「每字舉手」是每個字都長出手，適合短暱稱；「整句擁抱」是整句話被一雙手抱住，適合較長的句子或簽名檔。

guideZh.h: 適合用在哪？
guideZh.p: 遊戲暱稱、IG / Threads 簡介、留言裝可愛、朋友生日祝福。因為是純文字，各平台顯示都沒問題。

guideZh.h: 長名字該用哪種模式？
guideZh.p: 「每字舉手」會讓每個字都多出 2 個符號：3 字的暱稱會從 3 個字元變成 9 個。2–4 字的短暱稱用每字舉手最可愛；5 字以上、簽名檔或生日祝福這種長句子，改用「整句擁抱」——只在頭尾各加一隻手，整句只多 2 個字元，不會爆掉字數上限。

guideZh.h: 空格會被手包起來嗎？
guideZh.p: 不會。工具會保留空格原樣，只有真正的文字才會長出手。例如「加油 你好」會變成「୧加୨୧油୨ ୧你୨୧好୨」，中間的空格還在，方便你排版斷句。

faqZh.q: ୧ ୨ 是什麼符號？
faqZh.a: 是 Oriya 文的數字符號，長得像舉起的手臂，在顏文字圈（例如 ୧(•̀ᴗ•́)୨）已經用很久了，幾乎所有裝置都支援顯示。

faqZh.q: 跟韓國原版一樣嗎？
faqZh.a: 不一樣。韓國原版 팔다리 글씨是把韓文字母換成埃及象形文字，只支援韓文；這是專為中文設計的版本。

faqZh.q: 貼到遊戲暱稱變成方框 □ 怎麼辦？
faqZh.a: ୧ ୨ 屬於 Oriya 文區塊，手機和電腦的系統字型大多支援，但有些遊戲的內建字型沒有這個區塊，就會顯示方框。解法：先改用「整句擁抱」，把手臂從每字一對降到整句一對；或者先把結果貼到該遊戲的聊天欄測試，確認顯示正常再改名——遊戲改名多半要花錢，先測試比較保險。

faqZh.q: 為什麼字數一下就爆了？
faqZh.a: 平台算的是「字元數」不是「字數」：୧加油୨ 其實是 4 個字元；每字舉手的「加油」會變成 ୧加୨୧油୨，共 6 個字元。IG 簡介上限 150 字元、遊戲暱稱多半只有 8–12 字元，字數吃緊時就用「整句擁抱」。

guideEn.h: What is limb text?
guideEn.p: Inspired by Korea's 팔다리 글씨 (the original swaps Korean consonants, Korean-only). This version wraps each character in ୧ ୨ — little raised arms.

guideEn.h: Per-char or whole sentence?
guideEn.p: Per-char arms suit short nicknames; hugging the whole sentence suits longer lines and signatures.

guideEn.h: Per-char or whole sentence for long names?
guideEn.p: Per-char arms add 2 symbols per character: a 3-character name becomes 9 code points. Use per-char for short 2–4 character nicknames where cuteness matters; use whole-sentence hug for anything longer — it adds only 2 code points total, so you won't blow past character limits.

guideEn.h: What happens to spaces?
guideEn.p: Spaces are left alone — only real characters grow arms. "Fighting go" becomes "୧F୨୧i୨୧g୨୧h୨୧t୨୧i୨୧n୨୧g୨ ୧g୨୧o୨", keeping the space so you can still break lines naturally.

faqEn.q: Will ୧ ୨ display everywhere?
faqEn.a: Yes — they are long-used kaomoji arms with near-universal device support.

faqEn.q: Shows as boxes □ in my game?
faqEn.a: ୧ ୨ live in the Oriya Unicode block. Phones and computers render them fine, but some games ship with minimal fonts that lack this block. Fix: switch to whole-sentence hug (one pair of arms instead of one per character), or paste the result into that game's chat box first to test before spending money on a rename.

faqEn.q: Why did I hit the character limit so fast?
faqEn.a: Platforms count code points, not words: ୧加油୨ is 4 characters, and per-char "加油" becomes ୧加୨୧油୨ — 6 code points. IG bios cap at 150 characters and most game names allow only 8–12, so use whole-sentence hug when space is tight.

faqEn.q: Does it work with English letters?
faqEn.a: Yes. Each letter gets its own arms: "Hi" becomes ୧H୨୧i୨. Short English words and names look great in per-char mode.
